byd-electronic.name: BYD Electronic
byd-electronic.description: BYD Company Limited is a Chinese multinational manufacturing conglomerate headquartered in Shenzhen, Guangdong. It is vertically integrated with subsidiaries including BYD Auto and BYD Electronics, producing automobiles, electronic parts, and electric vehicle batteries.

banco-bilbao-vizcaya-argentaria.name: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria
banco-bilbao-vizcaya-argentaria.hq: Edificio del Banco de Bilbao, Spain
banco-bilbao-vizcaya-argentaria.description: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A. (BBVA) is a Spanish multinational financial services company headquartered in Bilbao with offices in Madrid. It is one of the largest financial institutions globally, with core markets in Spain, Mexico, South America, and Turkey.

bridgestone.name: Bridgestone
bridgestone.description: Bridgestone Corporation is a Japanese multinational tire and rubber manufacturing company based in Kyōbashi, Tokyo. Founded in 1931, it manufactures tires for automobiles, bicycles, motorcycles, and airplanes, as well as golf equipment. The company name is derived from a translation of the founder's surname.

bt-group.name: BT Group
bt-group.description: BT Group plc is a British multinational telecommunications holding company headquartered in London. It operates in around 180 countries and is the largest provider of fixed-line, broadband, and mobile services in the UK, also offering subscription television and IT services.

bath-body-works-inc.name: Bath & Body Works, Inc.
bath-body-works-inc.description: Bath & Body Works, Inc. is an American specialty retail company based in Columbus, Ohio. It owns the Bath & Body Works brand and was listed on the 2024 Fortune 500 list of largest US companies by revenue. The company operates in the retail sector.

bank-rakyat-indonesia.name: Bank Rakyat Indonesia
bank-rakyat-indonesia.description: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk, known as Bank BRI, is one of the largest banks in Indonesia. It specializes in small scale and microfinance borrowing and lending through over 8,600 branches and service posts. As of 2022, it is the second largest bank in Indonesia by asset.

bureau-veritas.name: Bureau Veritas
bureau-veritas.description: Bureau Veritas S.A. is a French company specializing in testing, inspection, and certification, founded in 1828. It operates across sectors including building, agri-food, marine, industry, certification, consumer products, and education.

baxter-international.name: Baxter International
baxter-international.description: Baxter International Inc. is an American multinational healthcare company headquartered in Deerfield, Illinois. It operates in the medical equipment industry.

baker-hughes.name: Baker Hughes
baker-hughes.description: Baker Hughes Company is an American global energy technology company co-headquartered in Houston, Texas and London, UK. It provides products and services to the oil and gas industry for exploration and production, as well as other energy and industrial applications. The company operates in over 120 countries worldwide.

boston-scientific.name: Boston Scientific
boston-scientific.description: Boston Scientific Corporation is an American biotechnology and biomedical engineering firm that manufactures medical devices used in various interventional medical specialties. These include interventional radiology, cardiology, neuromodulation, and oncology among others. It is a multinational company based in the United States.

baoshan-iron-steel.name: Baoshan Iron & Steel
baoshan-iron-steel.description: Baoshan Iron & Steel Co., Ltd., also known as Baosteel, is a steel manufacturer based in Shanghai, China. It is a subsidiary of the state-owned China Baowu Steel Group and is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

borgwarner.name: BorgWarner
borgwarner.description: BorgWarner Inc. is an American automotive and e-mobility supplier headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan. It operates 92 production facilities in 24 countries and is among the 25 largest automotive suppliers worldwide. Joseph F. Fadool became CEO in February 2025.

barnes-noble.name: Barnes & Noble
barnes-noble.description: Barnes & Noble Booksellers is an American bookseller with the largest number of retail outlets in the United States. The company operates approximately 600 retail stores across the country.

baidu.name: Baidu
baidu.description: Baidu, Inc. is a Chinese multinational technology company specializing in internet services and artificial intelligence. It holds a leading share of China's search engine market and offers services including Baidu App, Baidu Baike, iQIYI, and Baidu Tieba.

bristol-myers-squibb.name: Bristol-Myers Squibb
bristol-myers-squibb.description: Bristol-Myers Squibb Company is an American multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey. Its products include medications for cancer, autoimmune diseases, and blood disorders. In 2025, 69% of its revenues came from the United States.

banca-monte-dei-paschi-di-siena.name: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena
banca-monte-dei-paschi-di-siena.legal_name: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena
banca-monte-dei-paschi-di-siena.description: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena S.p.A. is an Italian bank with origins dating back to 1472. It is the world's oldest bank and, following its acquisition of Mediobanca in 2025, became the third largest bank in Italy.

listings.name: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena

bank-negara-indonesia.name: Bank Negara Indonesia
bank-negara-indonesia.description: PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk is an Indonesian state-owned bank with a large domestic branch network and several international branches. It is listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange and serves millions of customers primarily in Indonesia.

babcock-international.name: Babcock International
babcock-international.description: Babcock International Group plc is a British aerospace, defence and nuclear engineering services company based in London, England. It specializes in managing complex assets and infrastructure, mainly serving public bodies such as the UK's Ministry of Defence and Network Rail. The company operates in four sectors with overseas operations across multiple continents.

bashneft.name: Bashneft
bashneft.description: Bashneft is a Russian oil company formed from Soviet oil ministry assets in Bashkortostan and privatized in the early 2000s. It operates 140 oil and natural gas fields in Russia and owns three refineries in Ufa with a combined capacity of 820,000 barrels per day, along with 100 petrol stations. The company has experienced significant ownership changes and government involvement.

bunge-limited.name: Bunge Limited
bunge-limited.description: Bunge Global SA is a global agribusiness and food company incorporated in Geneva, Switzerland, with headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri, United States. It operates in the food industry worldwide.

beiersdorf.name: Beiersdorf
beiersdorf.description: Beiersdorf AG is a German multinational company headquartered in Hamburg that manufactures personal-care products and pressure-sensitive adhesives. Its brands include Nivea, Elastoplast, and Tesa. The company operates in the chemical industry focusing on consumer products.

blackrock.name: BlackRock
blackrock.description: BlackRock, Inc. is an American multinational investment company founded in 1988. Headquartered in New York City, it is the largest asset manager worldwide with offices in 30 countries and clients in 100 countries.

brenntag.name: Brenntag
brenntag.description: Brenntag SE is a German holding company specializing in the distribution of chemicals and ingredients. Founded in 1874 in Berlin, it is headquartered in Essen, Germany, and operates in more than 600 locations across 72 countries.

bluescope-steel.name: BlueScope Steel
bluescope-steel.description: BlueScope Steel Limited is an Australian flat product steel producer. The company was spun off from BHP Billiton in 2002 and operates in the iron and steel industry.

belaruskali.name: Belaruskali
belaruskali.description: Belaruskali is a large state-owned company in Belarus and one of the world's largest producers of potash fertilizers. As of 2019, it accounted for 20% of the global potash supply.

ball-corporation.name: Ball Corporation
ball-corporation.description: Ball Corporation is an American aluminum manufacturing company headquartered in Westminster, Colorado. Founded in 1880, it is known for producing glass jars and has expanded into aerospace technology and aluminum packaging manufacturing.

bic.name: Bic
bic.industry: Wholesale trade (business-to-business) of other household goods
bic.description: Société Bic S.A. is a French manufacturing corporation based in Clichy, Hauts-de-Seine. Founded in 1945, it produces disposable items including pens, stationery, lighters, and shaving razors.

bausch-lomb.name: Bausch & Lomb
bausch-lomb.description: Bausch & Lomb is an eye health products company based in Vaughan, Ontario. It produces contact lenses, intraocular lenses, medications, and products related to eye surgery. The company operates in the pharmaceutical and eye health sector.

bandai-namco-holdings.name: Bandai Namco Holdings
bandai-namco-holdings.description: Bandai Namco Holdings Inc. is a Japanese mass media and entertainment conglomerate founded in 2005 by merging Namco and Bandai. The company specializes in toys, video games, arcades, anime, restaurants, and amusement parks.

bally-s-corporation.name: Bally's Corporation
bally-s-corporation.description: Bally's Corporation is an American gambling, betting, and interactive entertainment company headquartered in Providence, Rhode Island. It operates casinos, a horse track, a golf course, and online sports betting across multiple states in the US and properties in Australia through a subsidiary.

brembo.name: Brembo
brembo.description: Brembo N.V. is an Italian manufacturer of automotive parts, notably producing braking systems for high-performance cars. Its operational head office is in Curno, Bergamo, Italy, with its legal seat in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

burberry.name: Burberry
burberry.description: Burberry Group plc is a British luxury fashion house established in 1856 and headquartered in London, England. It designs and distributes ready-to-wear clothing, including trench coats, leather accessories, and footwear.

banca-transilvania.name: Banca Transilvania
banca-transilvania.description: Banca Transilvania is a Romanian universal bank and financial services group headquartered in Cluj-Napoca. Founded in 1993 by local entrepreneurs, it has become the largest bank in Romania and Southeastern Europe with a significant share of national banking assets.

boryszew.name: Boryszew
boryszew.description: Boryszew SA is a Polish public company based in Sochaczew, listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange and part of the WIG30 index. It produces automotive components, chemical materials, metal oxides, and other metal elements, operating 30 production plants in 14 countries.

bio-rad-laboratories.name: Bio-Rad Laboratories
bio-rad-laboratories.description: Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc. is an American developer and manufacturer of specialized products for life science research and clinical diagnostics. Founded in 1952 in Berkeley, California, it is now based in Hercules, California, with operations worldwide.

braskem.name: Braskem
braskem.description: Braskem S.A is a Brazilian petrochemical company headquartered in São Paulo. It is the largest petrochemical company in Latin America and a significant player in the international petrochemical market.

bank-permata.name: Bank Permata
bank-permata.description: Permata Bank is an Indonesian bank headquartered in Jakarta. It serves nearly four million customers across 62 cities with 304 branch offices and two mobile branches. The bank became a BUKU IV bank after confirmation from the Financial Services Authority in January 2021.

balkrishna-industries.name: Balkrishna Industries
balkrishna-industries.description: Balkrishna Industries Limited (BKT) is an Indian multinational tyre manufacturer based in Mumbai. It produces off-highway tyres for mining, earthmoving, agriculture, and gardening from five factories. In 2013, it was ranked 41st among the world's tyre makers and sponsors various sports competitions.

brady-corporation.name: Brady Corporation
brady-corporation.description: Brady Corporation is an American developer and manufacturer of specialty products and technical equipment for workplace component identification. Headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, it was founded in 1914 and serves customers globally.

bank-sinarmas.name: Bank Sinarmas
bank-sinarmas.description: PT Bank Sinarmas Tbk is an Indonesian bank and subsidiary of Sinar Mas Multiartha. By the end of 2020, it operated numerous branch offices, sub-branch offices, cash offices, and sharia branches to support its banking activities.

birkenstock.name: Birkenstock
birkenstock.description: Birkenstock Holding plc is a German shoe manufacturer known for sandals with contoured cork footbeds made of suede and jute. Founded in 1774 and headquartered in Neustadt (Wied), Germany, the company aimed to create supportive shoes and expanded sales across Europe by 1925.

bezeq-the-israeli-telecommunication-corp.name: Bezeq The Israeli Telecommunication Corp. Ltd.
bezeq-the-israeli-telecommunication-corp.legal_name: Bezeq The Israeli Telecommunication Corp. Ltd.
bezeq-the-israeli-telecommunication-corp.description: Bezeq is an Israeli telecommunications company offering fixed-line, mobile telephony, high-speed Internet, fiber Internet transmission, and pay TV services. It operates through its subsidiaries providing a range of telecom services in Israel.

listings.name: Bezeq The Israeli Telecommunication Corp. Ltd.

blackstone-inc.name: Blackstone Inc.
blackstone-inc.description: Blackstone Inc. is an American alternative investment management company based in New York City. Founded in 1985, it is known for private equity, real estate acquisitions, and various investment activities globally.

bank-of-yokohama.name: Bank of Yokohama
bank-of-yokohama.hq: Bank of Yokohama Head Office Building, Japan
bank-of-yokohama.city: Bank of Yokohama Head Office Building
bank-of-yokohama.description: The Bank of Yokohama is the largest regional bank in Japan, headquartered in Yokohama. It operates mainly in Kanagawa Prefecture and southwestern Tokyo and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Yokohama Financial Group since 2016.

bank-of-cyprus.name: Bank of Cyprus
bank-of-cyprus.description: The Bank of Cyprus is a financial services company established in 1899 with headquarters in Strovolos, Cyprus.

bankinter.name: Bankinter
bankinter.description: Bankinter, S.A. is a Spanish financial services company headquartered in Madrid. Founded in 1965 as an industrial bank through a joint venture between Banco Santander and Bank of America, it has been listed on the Bolsa de Madrid since 1972.

bdo.name: BDO
bdo.description: BDO Unibank, Inc., commonly known as Banco de Oro (BDO), is a Philippine banking company based in Makati City. It is a member of the SM Group and has a presence in SM Malls throughout the Philippines.

bank-saint-petersburg.name: Bank Saint Petersburg
bank-saint-petersburg.description: Bank Saint Petersburg is a Russian bank established in 1990 and based in Saint Petersburg. It primarily operates in Northwest Russia and is listed on the Moscow Exchange.

bulgari.name: Bulgari
bulgari.description: Bulgari S.p.A. is an Italian luxury fashion house founded in 1884 and headquartered in Rome. It is known for jewellery, watches, fragrances, accessories, and leather goods and became a subsidiary of LVMH in 2011.

blackberry.name: BlackBerry
blackberry.description: BlackBerry Limited is a Canadian software company specializing in secure communications and the Internet of Things. Founded in 1984, it was known for its mobile devices until 2016 and now focuses on software, services, and patents.

barco.name: Barco
barco.description: Barco NV is a global technology company headquartered in Kortrijk, Belgium. It specializes in visualization, collaboration, and networking technology for entertainment, enterprise, and healthcare markets. The company holds over 900 patents and operates facilities across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

bumi-serpong-damai.name: Bumi Serpong Damai
bumi-serpong-damai.description: PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk manages BSD City, a planned community in Greater Jakarta, Indonesia. The city includes residential, commercial, and institutional facilities and is owned by Sinar Mas Land, a subsidiary of the Sinar Mas Group.

bentley-systems.name: Bentley Systems
bentley-systems.description: Bentley Systems, Incorporated is a US-based software development company providing software and services for the design, construction, and operation of infrastructure worldwide. Their products serve markets including architecture, engineering, construction, and operations for large assets like roads, bridges, and power plants.

bang-olufsen.name: Bang & Olufsen
bang-olufsen.description: Bang & Olufsen A/S is a Danish high-end consumer electronics company founded in 1925. It designs and manufactures audio products, television sets, and telephones, originally known for a radio designed to work with alternating current.

brunello-cucinelli.name: Brunello Cucinelli
brunello-cucinelli.description: Brunello Cucinelli S.p.A. is an Italian luxury fashion brand founded in 1978 by Brunello Cucinelli. The company sells menswear, womenswear, and accessories across Europe, the Americas, and East Asia. It is known for its high-end fashion products.

b-grimm.name: B.Grimm
b-grimm.description: B.Grimm Group is a multinational conglomerate founded in 1878 and based in Bangkok, Thailand. It operates in diverse sectors including healthcare, energy, building and industrial systems, real estate, e-commerce, and transport. The company is wholly owned and operated by the Link family.

bally-s-intralot.name: Bally's Intralot
bally-s-intralot.description: Bally's Intralot is a Greek gambling company providing integrated gambling systems, game content, sports betting management, and interactive services to state-licensed organizations worldwide. It operates in 39 countries and is publicly listed on the Athens Stock Exchange.

bavarian-nordic.name: Bavarian Nordic
bavarian-nordic.description: Bavarian Nordic A/S is a Danish biotechnology company focused on developing, manufacturing, and commercializing vaccines. It is headquartered in Hellerup, Denmark, with manufacturing facilities in Denmark and Switzerland, and research and development facilities in Germany and offices in the USA, Canada, and France.

biontech.name: BioNTech
biontech.description: BioNTech SE is a German multinational biotechnology company headquartered in Mainz. It develops immunotherapies and vaccines, focusing on cancer and infectious diseases.

bakkafrost.name: Bakkafrost
bakkafrost.description: P/F Bakkafrost is a Faroese salmon farming company based in Glyvrar on Eysturoy island in the Faroe Islands. It is the largest fish farming company and biggest private employer in the Faroe Islands, and the third-largest fish farming company globally.

bursa-malaysia.name: Bursa Malaysia
bursa-malaysia.description: Bursa Malaysia is the stock exchange of Malaysia, based in Kuala Lumpur and formerly known as the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange. It is one of the largest bourses in ASEAN and offers integrated transaction services including trading, settlement, clearing, and currency exchange.

ballard-power-systems.name: Ballard Power Systems
ballard-power-systems.description: Ballard Power Systems Inc. is a Canadian developer and manufacturer of proton exchange membrane fuel cell products. It serves markets including heavy-duty motive, portable power, and material handling. The company has designed and shipped over 400 MW of fuel cell products.

bradespar.name: Bradespar
bradespar.description: Bradespar is a Brazilian holding company headquartered in São Paulo. It was formed in 2000 by Banco Bradesco and holds large investments in mining company Vale, being one of its largest shareholders.

bitdeer.name: Bitdeer
bitdeer.description: Bitdeer Technologies Group is a cryptocurrency mining and artificial intelligence cloud infrastructure company headquartered in Singapore. Spun off from Bitmain in 2021, it operates data centers in the United States, Norway, and Bhutan. Since 2023, Bitdeer has expanded into AI cloud services through partnerships and facility conversions.

bjorn-borg-ab.name: Björn Borg AB
bjorn-borg-ab.description: Björn Borg AB is a Swedish apparel fashion brand named after the former professional tennis player Björn Borg. The company operates in the retail industry.

bank-of-greenland.name: Bank of Greenland
bank-of-greenland.description: The BANK of Greenland is one of two commercial banks in Greenland, headquartered in Nuuk. It is listed on the Copenhagen Stock Exchange and had 2,700 shareholders and 118 employees as of 2017.

barry-callebaut.name: Barry Callebaut
barry-callebaut.description: Barry Callebaut AG is a Swiss-Belgian cocoa processor and chocolate manufacturer based in Zürich, Switzerland. It was formed in 1996 by merging Cacao Barry and Callebaut and operates production sites worldwide.

bank-cimb-niaga.name: Bank CIMB Niaga
bank-cimb-niaga.description: PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk is an Indonesian private bank established in 1955 and majority-owned by Malaysian CIMB Group Holdings Berhad. It is the largest payment bank by transaction value and the third largest mortgage provider in Indonesia.

bluenord.name: BlueNord
bluenord.description: BlueNord ASA, formerly Norwegian Energy Company ASA, is an independent international petroleum company based in Norway. Established in 2005, it explores, develops, and produces oil and gas in the North Sea and operates in Norway, Denmark, and the UK.

buenaventura.name: Buenaventura
buenaventura.description: Compañia de Minas Buenaventura is a Peruvian company engaged in mining and exploration of precious metals including gold and silver. It operates in the mining industry in Peru.

build-a-bear-workshop.name: Build-A-Bear Workshop
build-a-bear-workshop.description: Build-A-Bear Workshop, Inc. is an American retailer headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. It sells teddy bears and stuffed animals that customers can customize with sounds, scents, clothing, and accessories.

bulgarian-stock-exchange.name: Bulgarian Stock Exchange
bulgarian-stock-exchange.description: The Bulgarian Stock Exchange is the only licensed and operating stock exchange in Bulgaria. It was founded on October 10, 1991.

bumi-resources.name: Bumi Resources
bumi-resources.description: PT Bumi Resources Tbk is a major Indonesian mining holding company and the largest producer of thermal coal in Indonesia. It is majority owned by the Bakrie Group and Salim Group.

buzzi.name: Buzzi
buzzi.description: Buzzi S.p.A. is an Italian company producing cement, ready-mix concrete, and construction aggregates. Headquartered in Casale Monferrato, it has subsidiaries and operations across Europe, North America, and Algeria.

bathurst-resources.name: Bathurst Resources
bathurst-resources.description: Bathurst Resources is a coal mining company based in New Zealand, established in 2010. It operates along with several subsidiaries in the mining sector. The company focuses on coal extraction and related activities.

bolsas-y-mercados-argentinos.name: Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos
bolsas-y-mercados-argentinos.description: Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos S.A. (BYMA) is an Argentine stock exchange and financial market infrastructure operator based in Buenos Aires. It provides securities trading, clearing, settlement services, and central securities depository services through its subsidiary Caja de Valores.

beike.name: Beike
beike.description: KE Holdings Inc. is a publicly listed Chinese real estate holding company that provides an integrated online and offline platform for housing transactions and services. It is the largest online real estate transaction platform in China.

bajaj-auto.name: Bajaj Auto
bajaj-auto.description: Bajaj Auto Limited is an Indian multinational automotive manufacturer based in Pune. It produces motorcycles, scooters, and auto rickshaws and is part of the Bajaj Group. The company was founded by Jamnalal Bajaj in Rajasthan in the 1940s.

bank-of-tianjin.name: Bank of Tianjin
bank-of-tianjin.description: Bank of Tianjin is a city commercial bank headquartered in Tianjin, China. It is regulated by the People's Bank of China. The bank operates in the financial services industry.

banco-santander-chile.name: Banco Santander-Chile
banco-santander-chile.description: Banco Santander-Chile is the largest bank in Chile by loans and deposits with a network of 504 branches. It is a subsidiary of the Santander Group and competes with Banco de Chile, Itaú Corpbanca, and BCI.

block-inc.name: Block, Inc.
block-inc.description: Block, Inc. is an American technology company and financial services provider for consumers and merchants. Founded in 2009 by Jack Dorsey, it is the U.S. market leader in point-of-sale systems.

bec-world.name: BEC World
bec-world.description: BEC World Public Company Limited is a Thai media conglomerate best known for operating television Channel 3. Founded in 1990 and listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand in 1995, it expanded its content businesses including Global Content Licensing, BEC Studio, and BEC Music.

blue-owl-capital.name: Blue Owl Capital
blue-owl-capital.description: Blue Owl Capital Inc. is an American alternative investment asset management company headquartered in New York City. It is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and has offices in London, Dubai, and Hong Kong.

bank-of-kaohsiung.name: Bank of Kaohsiung
bank-of-kaohsiung.description: The Bank of Kaohsiung is a public bank headquartered in Zuoying District, Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

bridge-investment-group.name: Bridge Investment Group
bridge-investment-group.description: Bridge Investment Group Holdings Inc. is an alternative investment company based in Salt Lake City, Utah. It focuses on real estate and credit investments and has expanded into private-equity secondary markets, property technology, and renewable energy.

bank-aljazira.name: Bank Aljazira
bank-aljazira.description: Aljazira Bank is a Saudi Arabian financial group founded in 1975 and headquartered in Jeddah. It operates as a joint-stock company providing financial services within Saudi Arabia.

bakrie-sumatera-plantations.name: Bakrie Sumatera Plantations
bakrie-sumatera-plantations.description: Bakrie Sumatera Plantations is an agricultural subsidiary of Bakrie Group based in Jakarta, Indonesia. It manages rubber and palm oil plantations, a railroad for transporting rubber, and several land banks. The company operates in the agriculture sector.

binggrae.name: Binggrae
binggrae.description: Binggrae Co., Ltd. is a South Korean multinational food and beverage corporation that manufactures ice cream, milk products, and snacks. Founded in 1967 as Daeil Corporation, it is known for releasing the first banana milk in 1974, Banana Flavored Milk, which became culturally important in South Korea.

biemlfdlkk.name: Biemlfdlkk
biemlfdlkk.description: Biemlofen, formerly Biemlfdlkk, is a Chinese golf apparel manufacturer founded in 2003. It focuses on high-end fashion sportswear and owns global trademark rights for Cerruti 1881 and Kent & Curwen. The company is owned by Xie Bingzheng.

bao-viet-holdings.name: Bao Viet Holdings
bao-viet-holdings.description: Bao Viet is the largest Vietnamese insurance company and the seventh largest listed company in Vietnam by market capitalization. It is state-owned, has a strategic partnership with HSBC, and has diversified into stock trading, fund management, real estate, banking, hotels, and construction.

batm-advanced-communications-ltd.name: Batm Advanced Communications Ltd
batm-advanced-communications-ltd.description: BATM Advanced Communications Ltd. is an Israeli technology company engaged in the development, production, and marketing of data and telecommunication products for local and wide area networks. It also develops and distributes laboratory diagnostic equipment in the medical sector. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE techMARK 100 Index.

berau-coal-energy.name: Berau Coal Energy
berau-coal-energy.description: PT Berau Coal Energy Tbk is a major coal producer based in Jakarta, Indonesia. It was Indonesia's fifth largest coal producer as of 2013. The company operates in the mining and metals industry.

banco-bmg.name: Banco BMG
banco-bmg.description: Banco BMG is a major retail bank in Brazil, originally founded in 1930 as Banco de Minas Gerais S.A. It operates in the finance sector serving retail banking customers.

bbcn.name: BBCN
bbcn.description: Bank of Hope is an American bank based in Los Angeles focusing on the Korean American community. It was originally established in 1980 under the name Wilshire Bank.

borgestad.name: Borgestad
borgestad.description: Borgestad ASA is a Norwegian company involved in shipping, industry, and real estate. It operates primarily through two divisions: Borgestad Properties and Borgestad Industries. The company is based in Norway.

brave-bison.name: Brave Bison
brave-bison.description: Brave Bison Group plc is a media, marketing, and technology company headquartered in London. It operates a digital media network with over 650 channels and 158 million followers. The company provides digital marketing, social media, fan engagement, marketing training, and technology consultancy services through various specialist divisions.

benitec-biopharma-ltd.name: Benitec Biopharma Ltd
benitec-biopharma-ltd.description: Benitec Biopharma Limited is an Australian biotechnology company founded in 1997. It develops gene-silencing therapies for chronic and life-threatening diseases using DNA-directed RNA interference technology. The company operates in the healthcare and pharmaceutical sector.

bupa-arabia.name: Bupa Arabia
bupa-arabia.description: Bupa Arabia is a Saudi-owned and operated publicly traded company providing health insurance in Saudi Arabia. It complies with the requirements of the Council of Cooperative Health Insurance and the Saudi Arabian Monetary Authority. The company has 800 million Saudi riyals in paid-in capital.

bausch-health.name: Bausch Health
bausch-health.description: Bausch Health Companies Inc. is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in Laval, Quebec, Canada, with an office in Bridgewater, New Jersey. It develops, manufactures, and markets pharmaceutical products across multiple medical fields and operates in more than 90 countries and regions worldwide.

bank-of-qingdao.name: Bank of Qingdao
bank-of-qingdao.description: Bank of Qingdao Company Limited provides retail and corporate banking services in Shandong province, China. Its headquarters are in Qingdao and it is regulated by the People's Bank of China.

bukalapak.name: Bukalapak
bukalapak.description: PT Bukalapak.com Tbk, trading as Bukalapak, is an Indonesian e-commerce company founded in 2010. It facilitates online commerce for small and medium enterprises and digitizes small family-owned businesses known as warungs through its Mitra programme. The company is based in Indonesia.

brixmor-property-group.name: Brixmor Property Group
brixmor-property-group.description: Brixmor Property Group is a publicly traded real estate investment trust in the United States. It invests in shopping centers as part of its real estate portfolio.

beyond-meat.name: Beyond Meat
beyond-meat.description: Beyond Meat, Inc. is a U.S.-based producer of plant-based meat alternatives founded in 2009. The company launched its products in the United States in 2012. It is known for its focus on plant-based food products.

bill-com-llc.name: Bill.com, LLC
bill-com-llc.description: BILL Holdings, Inc. is an American company based in San Jose, California, providing automated cloud-based software for financial operations targeting small businesses. It offers Bill.com Connect, a payments automation platform for financial institutions integrated into their online banking ecosystems.

booking-holdings.name: Booking Holdings
booking-holdings.description: Booking Holdings Inc. is an American travel technology company based in Norwalk, Connecticut. It owns and operates multiple travel fare aggregators and metasearch engines, including Booking.com and Priceline.com, serving customers in about 40 languages and 200 countries.

bursa-cimento.name: Bursa Çimento
bursa-cimento.description: Bursa Çimento is the sole cement factory in Bursa, Turkey, established in 1966 as a joint stock company. It has a production facility in Kütahya and maintains a 100% publicly traded capital. The factory's foundation was laid with participation from Prime Minister Süleyman Demirel.

bandhan-bank.name: Bandhan Bank
bandhan-bank.description: Bandhan Bank Ltd. is a private sector bank headquartered in Kolkata, India. It began as an NGO in 2001 and started universal banking operations in 2015, focusing on inclusive banking for unbanked and under-banked populations.

byco-petroleum.name: Byco Petroleum
byco-petroleum.description: Byco Petroleum, now known as Cnergyico Pk Limited, is a petroleum refinery based in Karachi, Pakistan. It is a subsidiary of the Mauritian company Cnergyico Industries Incorporated.

bank-of-baroda.name: Bank of Baroda
bank-of-baroda.description: Bank of Baroda is an Indian public sector bank headquartered in Vadodara, Gujarat. It is the second largest public sector bank in India after State Bank of India. The bank was ranked 455 on the Forbes Global 2000 list based on 2025 data.

beijing-yanjing-brewery.name: Beijing Yanjing Brewery
beijing-yanjing-brewery.description: Beijing Yanjing Brewery is a brewing company founded in 1980 and based in Beijing, China. It is known for Yanjing Beer, which was designated as the official beer served at state banquets in the Great Hall of the People in 1995.

bank-ozk.name: Bank OZK
bank-ozk.description: Bank OZK is a regional bank headquartered in Little Rock, Arkansas. It operates 265 offices across six states including Arkansas, Georgia, Florida, North Carolina, Texas, and Tennessee.

bnp-paribas-bank-polska.name: BNP Paribas Bank Polska
bnp-paribas-bank-polska.description: BNP Paribas Bank Polska is a Polish bank majority-owned by BNP Paribas of Paris. It originated from a joint venture established in 1994 and expanded significantly after BNP Paribas acquired BGZ Bank in 2015.

bumi-armada.name: Bumi Armada
bumi-armada.description: Bumi Armada Berhad is an oilfield services company based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It provides marine transportation, engineering, and maintenance services to the offshore oil and gas industry and is the world's fifth largest floating production storage and offloading provider.

black-stone-minerals.name: Black Stone Minerals
black-stone-minerals.description: Black Stone Minerals, L.P. is an oil and natural gas corporation based in Houston, Texas, United States. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

bok-financial-corporation.name: BOK Financial Corporation
bok-financial-corporation.description: BOK Financial Corporation is a financial services holding company headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma, USA. It offers retail and commercial banking products across the American Midwest and Southwest. It is among the 50 largest financial services firms in the US and the largest in Oklahoma.

boe-technology.name: BOE Technology
boe-technology.description: BOE Technology Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese electronic components producer founded in 1993. It specializes in interface devices, smart IoT systems, and smart medicine, and is one of the world's largest manufacturers of LCD, OLED, and flexible displays.

b2gold.name: B2Gold
b2gold.description: B2Gold Corporation is a Canadian mining company headquartered in Vancouver. Founded in 2007, it owns and operates gold mines in Canada, Mali, Namibia, and the Philippines. The company grew through mergers with several other mining companies and is listed on multiple stock exchanges.

baihe-com.name: baihe.com
baihe-com.description: Baihe.com is a Chinese online dating service founded in 2005 and operated by Baihe Network Company. It incorporates Sesame Credit data into its service and merged with its largest competitor, jiayuan.com, in December 2015.

bega-group.name: Bega Group
bega-group.description: The Bega Group is an Australian diversified food and drinks company with manufacturing sites across several states. Founded as an agricultural cooperative in Bega, New South Wales, it became a public company in 2011 and remains partly owned by its farmer-suppliers. It is a major player in Australia's dairy sector.

brookfield-property-partners.name: Brookfield Property Partners
brookfield-property-partners.description: Brookfield Property Partners L.P. is a limited partnership headquartered in Hamilton, Bermuda. It owns office buildings, shopping centers, and holds minority interests in investment funds that invest in commercial property. The company operates in the real estate sector.

banco-itau-corpbanca.name: Banco Itaú Corpbanca
banco-itau-corpbanca.description: Banco Itaú Corpbanca, known as Itaú Chile, is a Chilean commercial bank and subsidiary of Brazilian Itaú Unibanco. It is headquartered in Santiago and operates branches in Chile and Colombia, with offices in Lima, Madrid, Miami, and New York City.

brocade-communications-systems.name: Brocade Communications Systems
brocade-communications-systems.description: Brocade Communications Systems, Inc. was an American technology company specializing in storage networking products, including Fibre Channel technology. It expanded into IP/Ethernet hardware and software markets before becoming a subsidiary of Broadcom Inc.

blue-apron.name: Blue Apron
blue-apron.description: Blue Apron Holdings, Inc. is an American ingredient-and-recipe meal kit company headquartered in New York City. It operates exclusively in the United States, offering weekly boxes with ingredients and suggested recipes for customers to cook by hand.

betsson.name: Betsson
betsson.description: Betsson AB is a Swedish online gambling company operating more than 20 online gaming brands. It offers casino, poker, bingo, sports betting, and scratch cards through brands including Betsson, Betsafe, and NordicBet.

bpm-bank.name: BPM Bank
bpm-bank.description: Banco BPM S.p.A. is an Italian bank formed in 2017 by merging Banco Popolare and Banca Popolare di Milano. It is the third largest retail and corporate banking group in Italy, with dual headquarters in Verona and Milan.

builders-firstsource.name: Builders FirstSource
builders-firstsource.description: Builders FirstSource, Inc. is a publicly traded company headquartered in Irving, Texas, supplying building materials for residential construction and remodeling. Founded in 1998, it is the largest supplier of building products and services in the US.

blackline.name: BlackLine
blackline.description: BlackLine Systems, Inc. is an American enterprise software company based in Los Angeles. It develops cloud-based services to automate and manage financial close processes and related accounting functions.

beijing-enlight-media.name: Beijing Enlight Media
beijing-enlight-media.description: Beijing Enlight Media Co., Ltd is a Chinese publicly traded company specializing in TV program and film production through its subsidiary Beijing Enlight Pictures. The company was incorporated on April 24, 2000. It operates in the media and entertainment industry.

bbva-argentina.name: BBVA Argentina
bbva-argentina.description: BBVA Argentina, formerly BBVA Banco Francés, is a financial institution operating in Argentina. It provides various financial services within the country.

btg-pactual.name: BTG Pactual
btg-pactual.description: BTG Pactual is a global financial services group headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil, founded in 1983. It operates in 13 major financial centers worldwide and offers investment banking, wealth management, asset management, corporate lending, sales and trading, and consumer banking services.

banca-intesa-beograd.name: Banca Intesa Beograd
banca-intesa-beograd.description: Banca Intesa a.d. Beograd is a commercial bank in Serbia and a subsidiary of Intesa Sanpaolo. It operates within the Serbian financial sector.

bank-of-credit-and-investments.name: Bank of Credit and Investments
bank-of-credit-and-investments.description: Banco de Crédito e Inversiones (BCI) is a Chilean bank specializing in savings, deposits, securities brokerage, asset management, and insurance. It was the Latin American partner for Bear Stearns and is owned by the Yarur family. The bank is based in Chile.

banco-santander-brasil.name: Banco Santander (Brasil)
banco-santander-brasil.description: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. is the Brazilian subsidiary of the Spanish Santander Group, headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil. It is the fifth largest banking institution in Brazil and Latin America and the largest division of Santander outside Europe. The bank is publicly listed in São Paulo and New York.

beijing-capital-international-airport-co.name: Beijing Capital International Airport Company Limited
beijing-capital-international-airport-co.legal_name: Beijing Capital International Airport Company Limited
beijing-capital-international-airport-co.description: Beijing Capital International Airport Company Limited (BCIA) is majority owned by Capital Airport Holding and operates the Beijing Capital International Airport in Beijing, China. The company also provides related airport services.

listings.name: Beijing Capital International Airport Company Limited

bank-of-jerusalem-l-t-d.name: Bank Of Jerusalem L.t.d.
bank-of-jerusalem-l-t-d.description: Bank of Jerusalem, Ltd is Israel's seventh-largest bank, headquartered in Jerusalem with 25 branches around the country. It operates in the financial services sector providing banking services across Israel.

boise-cascade.name: Boise Cascade
boise-cascade.description: Boise Cascade Company is an American manufacturer of wood products and a wholesale distributor of building materials. It is headquartered in Boise, Idaho. The company operates primarily in the industrials and chemicals sector.

brainsway-ltd.name: Brainsway Ltd.
brainsway-ltd.description: BrainsWay Ltd. is an international medical technology company based in Israel that develops a medical device using H-coil for deep transcranial magnetic stimulation. This non-invasive treatment targets conditions such as depression, OCD, and smoking addiction. The company was founded in 2003 and has offices in the US and Jerusalem.

boyd-gaming.name: Boyd Gaming
boyd-gaming.description: Boyd Gaming Corporation is an American gambling and hospitality company based in Paradise, Nevada. It was founded in 1975 by Sam and Bill Boyd and operates in the gaming and hospitality industry.

broadvision.name: Broadvision
broadvision.description: BroadVision, Inc. is a software vendor based in Redwood City, California, United States. It provides self-service web applications for enterprise social software, e-commerce, portals, and customer relationship management. The company was founded in 1993 and went public in 1996.

bloom-energy.name: Bloom Energy
bloom-energy.description: Bloom Energy Corporation is an American company headquartered in San Jose, California, that designs and manufactures solid oxide fuel cells producing electricity onsite from natural gas. It also develops electrolyzers for hydrogen production and holds over 1000 patents globally.

bluebird-bio.name: bluebird bio
bluebird-bio.description: Genetix Biotherapeutics Inc., formerly known as bluebird bio, is a privately held biotechnology company based in Somerville, Massachusetts. It develops and commercializes genetic medicine for rare diseases, with three FDA-approved one-time gene addition cell therapies.

blue-prism.name: Blue Prism
blue-prism.description: SS&C Blue Prism, formerly Blue Prism Group plc, is a multinational software company that develops robotic process automation and business process management software. Founded in 2001 in the UK, it was acquired by SS&C Technologies in 2022 and now operates as SS&C Blue Prism. In 2026, it launched an automation platform integrating AI agents, robots, and people.

boxed-com.name: Boxed.com
boxed-com.description: Boxed, Inc. is an American online and mobile wholesale retailer based in New York City. Founded in 2013, it offers direct delivery of bulk-sized packages without membership via its app and website, with a product offering compared to that of Costco.

boohoo-group.name: Boohoo Group
boohoo-group.description: Boohoo Group plc is a United Kingdom-based online retail platform operating five core brands including Debenhams, Karen Millen, boohoo, boohooMAN, and PrettyLittleThing. It focuses on fashion, beauty, and lifestyle retail. The company trades as Debenhams Group.

bilibili.name: Bilibili
bilibili.description: Bilibili is a Chinese online video sharing platform based in Shanghai. It allows users to upload, view, and comment on videos, featuring a unique system of overlaid on-screen comments called danmu. The platform originally focused on animation, comics, and games but has expanded into other content types.

blyth-inc.name: Blyth, Inc.
blyth-inc.description: Blyth, Inc. is a marketing and manufacturing company based in Greenwich, Connecticut. It sells personal and decorative products and was the largest candlemaker in the United States in 2001. Its subsidiaries include multi-level marketing companies PartyLite and Visalus.

bharat-dynamics-limited.name: Bharat Dynamics Limited
bharat-dynamics-limited.description: Bharat Dynamics Limited is an Indian manufacturer of ammunitions and missile systems founded in 1970 in Hyderabad. It collaborates with the Defence Research and Development Organisation and foreign OEMs to supply missiles and related equipment to the Indian Armed Forces. The company has three manufacturing units in India.

bharat-electronics.name: Bharat Electronics
bharat-electronics.description: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) is an Indian public sector aerospace and defence electronics company headquartered in Bengaluru. It manufactures advanced electronic products for ground and aerospace applications and is administered by the Ministry of Defence of India with Navratna status.

baotou-steel.name: Baotou Steel
baotou-steel.description: Baotou Iron and Steel Group, also known as Baotou Steel or Baogang Group, is a state-owned iron and steel enterprise based in Baotou, Inner Mongolia, China. Established in 1954 and reorganized in 1998, it is the largest steel enterprise in Inner Mongolia and has the largest rare earth research and production base in China.

black-box-corporation.name: Black Box Corporation
black-box-corporation.description: Black Box Corporation is an IT company headquartered in Texas, United States. It provides technology assistance and consulting services across sectors including retail, transportation, government, education, and public safety. The company operates in 75 locations across 35 countries.

bloober-team.name: Bloober Team
bloober-team.description: Bloober Team S.A. is a Polish video game developer based in Kraków, founded in 2008. It is known for creating horror games like Layers of Fear and The Medium. The company owns the third-party publisher Feardemic and has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 2024.

bank-of-beijing.name: Bank of Beijing
bank-of-beijing.description: Bank of Beijing Co., Ltd. is an urban commercial bank based in Beijing, China. Most revenue comes from Beijing, though over half of its branches are outside the municipality. Major shareholders include the Beijing Municipal Government and ING Bank.

brown-forman.name: Brown-Forman
brown-forman.description: Brown-Forman Corporation is an American family-controlled publicly traded company based in Louisville, Kentucky. It is one of the largest companies in the spirits and wine business and manufactures several well-known brands worldwide, including Jack Daniel's and Old Forester.

bank-handlowy.name: Bank Handlowy
bank-handlowy.description: Bank Handlowy w Warszawie S.A., rebranded as Citibank Handlowy and later Citi Handlowy, is a Polish bank based in Warsaw. It is one of Poland's oldest banks and ranks 10th by assets and 18th by number of outlets.

bossini.name: Bossini
bossini.description: Bossini International Holdings Limited is an apparel brand owner, retailer, and franchiser headquartered in Hong Kong. It operates mainly in Hong Kong, mainland China, Taiwan, Thailand, and Singapore. The company focuses on the fashion industry in these Asian markets.

bank-islam-malaysia.name: Bank Islam Malaysia
bank-islam-malaysia.description: Bank Islam Malaysia Berhad is an Islamic bank based in Malaysia, established in July 1983. It was created primarily to serve the financial needs of the Muslim population and later extended services to the broader population.

bank-of-shanghai.name: Bank of Shanghai
bank-of-shanghai.description: Bank of Shanghai Co., Ltd. (BOSC) is an urban commercial bank based in Shanghai, China. It was ranked 73rd among 1000 banks worldwide by The Banker in terms of Tier 1 capital in 2020.

bambuser.name: Bambuser
bambuser.description: Bambuser AB is a Swedish company founded in 2007 and headquartered in Stockholm. It offers a video commerce platform aimed at brands seeking to create engaging and personalized shopping experiences. Bambuser is listed on the Nasdaq First North stock exchange.

bbmg.name: BBMG
bbmg.description: BBMG Corporation Ltd. is a cement producer and property developer headquartered in Beijing, China. It is the largest supplier of building materials in Beijing, Tianjin, and Hebei province. The company operates primarily in the real estate and building materials sector.

bitstream-inc.name: Bitstream Inc.
bitstream-inc.description: Bitstream Inc. was an American type foundry founded in 1981 and located in Marlborough, Massachusetts. It produced digital typefaces and was founded by former employees of Mergenthaler Linotype Company. Its font business was acquired by Monotype Imaging in 2012, and the remaining business was renamed Pageflex, Inc.

baloise.name: Bâloise
baloise.description: Bâloise Holding AG is a Swiss insurance holding company founded in 1863 and headquartered in Basel.

bank-of-the-ryukyus.name: Bank of the Ryukyus
bank-of-the-ryukyus.description: Bank of The Ryukyus, Limited is a Japanese regional bank serving Okinawa Prefecture in Japan. It operates as a bank focused on regional financial services.

biovia.name: BIOVIA
biovia.description: BIOVIA is a software company headquartered in the United States with representation in Europe and Asia. It provides software for chemical, materials, and bioscience research across multiple industries including pharmaceutical and biotechnology.

bwin-party-digital-entertainment.name: bwin.party digital entertainment
bwin-party-digital-entertainment.description: Bwin.Party Digital Entertainment was an online gambling company formed by the 2011 merger of PartyGaming plc and Bwin Interactive Entertainment AG. It was known for its online poker room PartyPoker, World Poker Tour, and sports betting brand Bwin.

be-aerospace.name: BE Aerospace
be-aerospace.description: B/E Aerospace, Inc. was a manufacturer of aircraft passenger cabin interior products for commercial and business jet aircraft markets. Based in Wellington, Florida, it served airlines, aircraft manufacturers, and leasing companies worldwide. The company held leading market shares in its major product lines.

bgc-partners.name: BGC Partners
bgc-partners.description: BGC Group, Inc. is a global financial services company based in New York City and London. It was originally part of Cantor Fitzgerald and became an independent entity in 2004. The company operates in the finance sector.

bj-s-restaurant-brewery.name: BJ's Restaurant & Brewery
bj-s-restaurant-brewery.description: BJ's Restaurants, Inc. is an American restaurant chain headquartered in Huntington Beach, California. It operates under several names including BJ's Restaurant & Brewery and BJ's Pizza & Grill. The company is part of the consumer goods and retail industry.

bwx-technologies.name: BWX Technologies
bwx-technologies.description: BWX Technologies, Inc. is an American company headquartered in Lynchburg, Virginia. It supplies nuclear components and fuel internationally, operating in the renewables and utilities sector.

bw-offshore.name: BW Offshore
bw-offshore.description: BW Offshore Limited is a global owner and operator of floating production storage and offloading vessels. Headquartered in Singapore and Oslo, Norway, it operates internationally and is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange. BW Group Limited owns nearly half of the company.

b-m.name: B&M
b-m.description: B & M Retail Limited, trading as B&M, is a British multinational variety store and garden centre chain founded in 1978 and based in Liverpool, England. It is part of B&M European Value Retail plc, which also owns Heron Foods and operates B&M stores in France.

b-communications-ltd.name: B Communications Ltd
b-communications-ltd.description: Bezeq is an Israeli telecommunications company offering fixed-line, mobile telephony, high-speed Internet, fiber Internet transmission, and pay TV services. It operates in the telecommunications industry in Israel.

bachoco.name: Bachoco
bachoco.description: Industrias Bachoco, S.A. de C.V., known as Bachoco, is a Mexican poultry producer. It operates in preparing feed, breeding and growing chickens, and processing and distributing chicken products. The company also engages in swine farming.

backblaze.name: Backblaze
backblaze.description: Backblaze, Inc. is an American cloud storage and data backup company based in San Mateo, California. Founded in 2007, it provides services for both business and personal markets.

boston-properties.name: Boston Properties
boston-properties.description: BXP, Inc., known as Boston Properties, is a publicly traded real estate investment trust in the United States. It invests in premier workplaces across major cities including Boston, Los Angeles, and New York City.

bajaj-electricals.name: Bajaj Electricals
bajaj-electricals.description: Bajaj Electricals Ltd. is an Indian consumer electrical equipment manufacturer headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra. It is part of the Bajaj Group and has diversified interests including lighting, appliances, and engineering projects.

bakrie-group.name: Bakrie Group
bakrie-group.description: The Bakrie Group is an Indonesian conglomerate founded in 1942 by Achmad Bakrie. It holds ownership in various industries such as mining, oil and gas, property development, and telecommunications.

bancfirst.name: BancFirst
bancfirst.description: BancFirst Corporation is a financial services holding company based in Oklahoma, United States. It operates three subsidiary banks including BancFirst, Pegasus Bank, and Worthington Bank.

bank-of-brasilia.name: Bank of Brasilia
bank-of-brasilia.description: BRB Banco de Brasília S.A, commonly known as Banco de Brasília, is a state-owned Brazilian bank controlled by the Federal District government. It offers various financial products including savings accounts, credit cards, investment services, insurance, and loans. Founded in 1983, it is headquartered in Brasília, DF, and is listed on the B3 stock exchange in São Paulo.

banco-do-estado-do-espirito-santo.name: Banco do Estado do Espírito Santo
banco-do-estado-do-espirito-santo.legal_name: Banco do Estado do Espírito Santo
banco-do-estado-do-espirito-santo.description: Banestes is a Brazilian state-owned bank responsible for public loan execution in the state of Espírito Santo. It serves as a major instrument for the state's economic development.

listings.name: Banco do Estado do Espírito Santo

bangkok-land.name: Bangkok Land
bangkok-land.description: Bangkok Land Public Company Limited is a real estate company based in Thailand. It is known for developing Muang Thong Thani, a large residential project in Pak Kret, Nonthaburi Province, a northern suburb of Bangkok.

bankunited.name: BankUnited
bankunited.description: BankUnited, Inc. is the holding company of BankUnited, N.A., a national bank founded in 1984 and headquartered in Miami Lakes, Florida. It operates in Florida and several other US regions including Atlanta, Dallas, Morristown, Charlotte, and the New York metropolitan area.

bank-millennium.name: Bank Millennium
bank-millennium.description: Bank Millennium S.A. is a commercial bank based in Warsaw, Poland. It is considered one of the most systemically important banks in the country.

bank-of-florida.name: Bank of Florida
bank-of-florida.description: Bank of Florida Corporation was a bank holding company based in Naples, Florida. It operated three separate banks serving different regions: Southwest, Southeast, and Tampa Bay. The company was focused on banking services within Florida.

bank-of-hawaii.name: Bank of Hawaii
bank-of-hawaii.description: The Bank of Hawaii Corporation is a regional commercial bank headquartered in Honolulu, Hawaii. It is the state's second oldest and largest locally owned bank, with the majority of voting stockholders residing in Hawaii. The bank operates four business segments including retail and commercial banking.

bank-of-new-orleans.name: Bank of New Orleans
bank-of-new-orleans.description: Bank of New Orleans was a bank headquartered in Metairie, Louisiana, and a subsidiary of Louisiana Bancorp, Inc. It operated four branches within Louisiana. In 2015, it was acquired by Home Bancorp, Inc.

bank-of-ningbo.name: Bank of Ningbo
bank-of-ningbo.description: Bank of Ningbo Co., Ltd. is a city-based commercial bank headquartered in Ningbo, Zhejiang, China. As of 2015, it operated 30 branches across cities in the Yangtze River Delta area and other major cities including Beijing and Shenzhen.

bnc-bank.name: BNC Bank
bnc-bank.description: BNC Bank was a bank based in High Point, North Carolina, United States. Before its acquisition in 2017, it operated numerous branches across North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, and Haiti. It was taken over by Pinnacle Financial Partners in 2017.

bank-of-queensland.name: Bank of Queensland
bank-of-queensland.description: The Bank of Queensland is an Australian retail bank headquartered in Brisbane, Queensland. Founded originally as a building society in 1874, it operates numerous branches and ATMs across Australia. The bank also owns Virgin Money Australia and ME Bank.

bank-of-syria-and-overseas.name: Bank of Syria and Overseas
bank-of-syria-and-overseas.description: Bank of Syria and Overseas is one of the first private banks established in Syria, starting operations in January 2004. It is part of the BLOM Bank Group. The bank provides various banking services within Syria.

banpu.name: Banpu
banpu.description: Banpu Public Company Limited is an energy company based in Thailand. Its core businesses include energy resources, energy generation, and energy technology. In 2012, it was ranked among the Forbes Global 2000 largest public companies.

banque-bemo-saudi-fransi.name: Banque Bemo Saudi Fransi
banque-bemo-saudi-fransi.description: Banque Bemo Saudi Fransi is a private bank in Syria. It was the first operational private bank in Syria in nearly 20 years when it launched in 2004. Its main shareholders are Lebanese Banque Bemo S.A.L. and Saudi Banque Saudi Fransi.

banco-do-estado-do-rio-grande-do-sul.name: Banco do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul
banco-do-estado-do-rio-grande-do-sul.legal_name: Banco do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul
banco-do-estado-do-rio-grande-do-sul.description: Banrisul is a Brazilian bank and the largest in Southern Brazil. It primarily operates in Rio Grande do Sul with a network serving over 365 cities and maintains agencies in Miami and Grand Cayman.

listings.name: Banco do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul

barnes-group.name: Barnes Group
barnes-group.description: Barnes Group Inc. is a global industrial technology and aerospace manufacturer and service provider based in the United States.

bassett-furniture.name: Bassett Furniture
bassett-furniture.description: Bassett Furniture Industries, Inc. is a furniture manufacturer and retailer headquartered in Bassett, Virginia, United States. Founded in 1902, it is one of the oldest furniture manufacturers in Virginia.

beasley-broadcast-group.name: Beasley Broadcast Group
beasley-broadcast-group.description: Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc. is a radio station owner and operator based in Naples, Florida. As of October 2026, it owns 47 radio stations under the Beasley Media Group name across the United States.

biocon.name: Biocon
biocon.description: Biocon Limited is an Indian biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Bengaluru with U.S. headquarters in Bridgewater, New Jersey. Founded in 1978, it manufactures generic active pharmaceutical ingredients and novel biologics, including biosimilar insulins and antibodies, sold in about 120 countries.

beazer-homes-usa.name: Beazer Homes USA
beazer-homes-usa.description: Beazer Homes USA, Inc. is a home construction company based in Atlanta, Georgia. In 2016, it was the 11th largest home builder in the United States by homes closed and operates in 13 states.

bebe-stores.name: Bebe Stores
bebe-stores.description: Bebe Stores, Inc. is a women's retail brand established in 1976 in the United States. It develops and produces women's apparel, accessories, and perfume fragrances marketed under the Bebe, Bebe Sport, and Bebe Outlet names.

beijing-jingneng-power-co-ltd.name: Beijing Jingneng Power Co., Ltd.
beijing-jingneng-power-co-ltd.description: Beijing Jingneng Power Co., Ltd. is a coal power producer and district heating supplier based in Beijing, China. It is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

benchmark-electronics.name: Benchmark Electronics
benchmark-electronics.description: Benchmark Electronics Inc. is an American engineering and manufacturing company headquartered in Tempe, Arizona. Founded in 1979, it provides engineering and manufacturing services to original equipment manufacturers in industries such as aerospace, defense, medical, and advanced computing.

bendigo-bank.name: Bendigo Bank
bendigo-bank.description: Bendigo and Adelaide Bank is an Australian financial institution primarily operating in retail banking. The company was formed by the merger of Bendigo Bank and Adelaide Bank in November 2007.

berkeley-group-holdings.name: Berkeley Group Holdings
berkeley-group-holdings.description: The Berkeley Group Holdings plc is a British property developer and house-builder based in Cobham, England. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

berry-plastics.name: Berry Plastics
berry-plastics.description: Berry Global Group, Inc. is a global manufacturer and marketer of plastic packaging products headquartered in Evansville, Indiana. It operates over 265 facilities worldwide and employs more than 46,000 people. The company was once a Fortune 500 entity.

best-less.name: Best & Less
best-less.description: Best & Less is an Australian retailer specializing in clothing and household linens. As of October 2022, it operates 182 stores and also offers products through an online platform. The company is based in Australia.

berkshire-bank.name: Berkshire Bank
berkshire-bank.description: Berkshire Bank was an American bank headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, operating branches in New England and New York. It was the third largest regional bank based in Massachusetts before merging with Brookline Bancorp to form Beacon Bank.

bharat-forge.name: Bharat Forge
bharat-forge.description: Bharat Forge Limited is an Indian multinational company involved in forging and various industries including automotive, energy, construction, mining, railways, marine, aerospace, and defense. It is based in India.

bic-camera.name: Bic Camera
bic-camera.description: Bic Camera, Inc. is a Japanese consumer electronics retailer with 45 stores across 17 prefectures. It owns 50% of Kojima and fully owns Sofmap, a computer store chain.

biffa.name: Biffa
biffa.description: Biffa Limited is a UK-based waste management company providing collection, landfill, recycling, and special waste services. Headquartered in High Wycombe, it was the UK's second-largest waste management firm in 2017 and was acquired by Energy Capital Partners in 2023.

big-lots.name: Big Lots
big-lots.description: Big Lots Stores, Inc. is an American discount retail chain specializing in closeout and overstock merchandise. Founded in 1967 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, it operates over 200 locations across the United States.

bill-barrett-corporation.name: Bill Barrett Corporation
bill-barrett-corporation.description: Bill Barrett Corporation was an energy company based in Denver, Colorado, focused on natural gas and oil exploration and development in the Rocky Mountains region of the United States.

biocryst-pharmaceuticals.name: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals
biocryst-pharmaceuticals.description: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Durham, North Carolina. It develops medicines for hereditary angioedema and rare diseases, with FDA-approved antiviral drugs peramivir and berotralstat.

biogaia.name: BioGaia
biogaia.description: BioGaia is a Swedish biotechnology company that develops, markets, and sells probiotic products. It has patented several Lactobacillus reuteri strains and offers products for gut, immune, and oral health. BioGaia's shares are listed on the NASDAQ OMX Nordic Exchange.

bioline-rx-ltd.name: Bioline Rx Ltd.
bioline-rx-ltd.description: BioLineRx Ltd. is a publicly traded drug development company headquartered in Israel. Its shares are traded on the NASDAQ Capital Market and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

biomarin-pharmaceutical.name: BioMarin Pharmaceutical
biomarin-pharmaceutical.description: BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc. is an American biotechnology company based in San Rafael, California. It focuses on enzyme replacement therapies and was the first to provide therapeutics for mucopolysaccharidosis type I and phenylketonuria.

biohit.name: Biohit
biohit.description: Biohit Oyj is a Finnish company that develops, manufactures, and markets biotech and diagnostics products for research and healthcare use.

biotie-therapies.name: Biotie Therapies
biotie-therapies.description: Biotie Therapies Oyj was a Finnish biotechnology and pharmaceutics company focused on drugs for neurodegenerative, psychiatric, and liver diseases. It was headquartered in Turku, Finland, and was acquired by Acorda Therapeutics in 2016.

birdstep-technology.name: Birdstep Technology
birdstep-technology.description: Birdstep Technology is a public company founded in 1996 and headquartered in Oslo, Norway. It provides Smart Mobile Data and Secure Mobility solutions globally for operators, enterprises, and governments.

bluephoenix-solutions.name: BluePhoenix Solutions
bluephoenix-solutions.description: BluePhoenix Solutions Ltd. was a publicly traded company headquartered in Israel that developed and sold modernization services for legacy IT systems. Its shares were traded on the NASDAQ Global Market exchange.

blue-nile-inc.name: Blue Nile Inc.
blue-nile-inc.description: Blue Nile Inc. is an American jewellery company based in New York City. It became a subsidiary of Bain Capital in 2017 and was acquired by Signet Jewelers in 2022.

boart-longyear.name: Boart Longyear
boart-longyear.description: Boart Longyear is an international mineral exploration company founded in 1890 in the United States. Headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, it provides mineral exploration services and drilling products for mining and other sectors worldwide.

boingo-wireless.name: Boingo Wireless
boingo-wireless.description: Boingo Wireless, Inc. is an American company that designs, builds, and manages wireless networks including distributed antenna systems, small cells, and macro towers. It operates over one million Wi-Fi hotspots worldwide and serves locations such as airports, stadiums, and military bases. The company moved its headquarters to Frisco, Texas in December 2022.

books-a-million.name: Books-A-Million
books-a-million.description: Books-A-Million, Inc., also known as BAM!, is a bookstore chain in the United States operating 260 stores across 32 states. Stores sell books, magazines, collectibles, toys, technology, and gifts, and most feature Joe Muggs cafés. The stores operate under several names including Books-A-Million and 2nd & Charles.

boral.name: Boral
boral.description: Boral Limited is an Australian building and construction materials company. It is owned by Seven Group Holdings.

bosideng.name: Bosideng
bosideng.description: Bosideng International Holdings Limited is the largest down clothing company in China. It sells down clothing under six core brands, including Bosideng and Snow Flying, targeting various consumer segments. In 2023, it was ranked 462nd in the World's 500 Most Influential Brands list by World Brand Lab.

box.name: Box
box.description: Box, Inc. is an American public company based in Redwood City, California, that develops cloud-based content management and file sharing tools for businesses. Founded in 2005, it shifted focus from consumers to business users around 2009-2010. Its software enables file storage, collaboration, and security across devices.

brandywine-realty-trust.name: Brandywine Realty Trust
brandywine-realty-trust.description: Brandywine Realty Trust is a real estate investment trust based in Philadelphia. It invests in office buildings located in Philadelphia, Washington, D.C., and Austin, Texas.

bright-horizons.name: Bright Horizons
bright-horizons.description: Bright Horizons Family Solutions Inc. is a US-based child-care provider headquartered in Newton, Massachusetts. It is the largest provider of employer-sponsored child care and also offers back-up child care, elder care, tuition program management, education advising, and student loan repayment programs.

brightcove.name: Brightcove
brightcove.description: Brightcove, Inc. is an American software company based in Boston, Massachusetts, producing an online video platform. Founded in 2004, it went public in 2012 and was acquired by Bending Spoons in 2025.

briscoe-group.name: Briscoe Group
briscoe-group.description: Briscoe Group Limited is a major retail company based in New Zealand operating 92 stores nationwide under the Briscoes Homeware and Rebel Sport brands. Established in Dunedin in 1861, it originally supplied goods to gold miners during the Otago gold rush. It remains one of New Zealand's most prominent retail businesses.

bristow-helicopters.name: Bristow Helicopters
bristow-helicopters.description: Bristow Helicopters Limited is a British civil helicopter operator founded in 1955 in Scotland and originally based at Aberdeen Airport. It is part of the US-based Bristow Group Inc, headquartered in Houston, Texas. In 2020, Bristow Group merged with Era Helicopters, continuing to use the Bristow name.

britannia-industries.name: Britannia Industries
britannia-industries.description: Britannia Industries Limited is an Indian multinational food products company selling biscuits, breads, and dairy products. Founded in 1892, it is one of India's oldest companies and part of the Wadia Group. About 80% of its revenues come from biscuit products as of 2023.

broadridge-financial-solutions.name: Broadridge Financial Solutions
broadridge-financial-solutions.description: Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. is a public financial technology company headquartered in Lake Success, New York. Founded in 2007 as a spin-off from Automatic Data Processing, it supplies financial documents and shareholder communications solutions to companies in the financial industry.

broadway-federal-bank.name: Broadway Federal Bank
broadway-federal-bank.description: Broadway Federal Bank was a community-focused bank founded in 1946 and based in Los Angeles. As of 2020, it operated three traditional branches and one loan production office.

brookdale-senior-living.name: Brookdale Senior Living
brookdale-senior-living.description: Brookdale Senior Living Solutions owns and operates retirement homes across the United States. Established in 1978 and based in Brentwood, Tennessee, it is the largest operator of senior housing in the US with over 51,000 residents as of December 31, 2025.

brown-brown.name: Brown & Brown
brown-brown.description: Brown & Brown, Inc. is an American insurance brokerage firm headquartered in Daytona Beach, Florida. It is one of the largest independent insurance intermediaries in the US, providing risk management solutions, insurance products, and services to various clients including businesses and governmental institutions.

brdrene-hartmann.name: Brødrene Hartmann
brdrene-hartmann.description: Brødrene Hartmann A/S is a Danish company that manufactures moulded-fibre packaging, including egg and fruit packaging. It is the world’s leading manufacturer of moulded-fibre egg packaging and the largest manufacturer of technology for producing moulded-fibre packaging.

bsquare-corporation.name: Bsquare corporation
bsquare-corporation.description: Bsquare was a technology company based in Seattle, Washington, providing Internet of Things (IoT) systems software, device management, and professional development services. It supported OEMs, ODMs, and enterprises with OS licenses and system integration.

buckeye-partners.name: Buckeye Partners
buckeye-partners.description: Buckeye Partners is a petroleum distributor operating in the East and Midwest United States. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, it is one of the largest independent oil pipeline companies and a descendant of Standard Oil.

buckle.name: Buckle
buckle.description: The Buckle, Inc. is an American fashion retailer selling clothing, footwear, and accessories for men, women, and children. It operates 451 stores across 42 U.S. states under the names Buckle and The Buckle.

burgerfuel.name: BurgerFuel
burgerfuel.description: BurgerFuel is a New Zealand-based burger restaurant and franchise with 72 locations across three countries, including 60 in New Zealand. It operates in the restaurant industry, focusing on burger offerings.

burlington.name: Burlington
burlington.description: Burlington Stores is an American off-price retailer with over 1,287 stores in 47 states and Puerto Rico. Headquartered in Burlington, New Jersey, it is a division of Burlington Coat Factory Warehouse Corporation and is the third largest off-price retailer in the U.S.

busey-bank.name: Busey Bank
busey-bank.description: First Busey Bank is a financial institution headquartered in Champaign, Illinois, operating in 10 states. It is owned by First Busey Holding, a financial holding company.

bard.name: Bard
bard.description: C. R. Bard, Inc. was a medical technology company based in Murray Hill, New Jersey, specializing in vascular medicine, urology, oncology, and surgical specialties. It is known for introducing the Foley catheter in 1934.

best-buy.name: Best Buy
best-buy.description: Best Buy Co., Inc. is an American multinational consumer electronics retailer headquartered in Richfield, Minnesota. Founded in 1966 as Sound of Music, it was rebranded as Best Buy in 1983 with a focus on consumer electronics.

biondvax.name: BiondVax
biondvax.description: BiondVax Pharmaceuticals Ltd. is an Israeli biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and manufacturing immunotherapeutic products. Its primary focus is on treatments for infectious and autoimmune diseases.

b-g-foods.name: B&G Foods
b-g-foods.description: B&G Foods, Inc. is an American branded foods holding company based in Parsippany, New Jersey. It was formed in 1996 to acquire Bloch & Guggenheimer, a Manhattan-based producer of pickles, relish, and condiments founded in 1889.

bird.name: Bird
bird.description: Bird Global, Inc. is a micromobility company based in Miami, Florida, founded in 2017. It distributes electric scooters for short-term rental in over 350 cities. In 2024, it was acquired by Third Lane Mobility to avoid bankruptcy.

blacksky.name: BlackSky
blacksky.description: BlackSky Technology Inc. is an American company providing geospatial intelligence services including satellite imagery and data analytics. Headquartered in Herndon, Virginia, it operates small satellites in low Earth orbit and serves government and commercial customers through its imagery products and software platform BlackSky Spectra.

bloomsbury-publishing.name: Bloomsbury Publishing
bloomsbury-publishing.description: Bloomsbury Publishing plc is a British worldwide publishing house of fiction and non-fiction. Its head office is located in Bloomsbury, London, with additional offices in New York City, New Delhi, Sydney, and Oxford. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

barratt-developments.name: Barratt Developments
barratt-developments.description: Barratt Redrow plc is a British residential property development company operating across England, Wales, and Scotland. Originally based in Newcastle upon Tyne, it is now located in Coalville, England. The company is a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index.

blink.name: Blink
blink.description: Blink Charging Co. is an American operator of electric vehicle charging networks headquartered in Bowie, Maryland. It is among the top three EV charging networks in the United States and has over 90,000 chargers across 25 countries globally.

bombay-stock-exchange.name: Bombay Stock Exchange
bombay-stock-exchange.description: The Bombay Stock Exchange is an Indian stock exchange located in Mumbai. Established in 1875, it is the oldest stock exchange in Asia and the tenth oldest in the world.

black-rifle-coffee-company.name: Black Rifle Coffee Company
black-rifle-coffee-company.description: Black Rifle Coffee Company is a coffee company based in West Valley City, Utah, founded in 2014 by former U.S. Army Green Beret Evan Hafer. It gained attention for pledging to hire veterans and military spouses.

bushiroad.name: Bushiroad
bushiroad.description: Bushiroad Inc. is a Japanese entertainment company founded in 2007 and headquartered in Tokyo. It produces collectible card games, trading cards, and mobile apps and games, and owns various media franchises.

bangchak-petroleum-public-company-limite.name: Bangchak Petroleum Public Company Limited
bangchak-petroleum-public-company-limite.description: Bangchak Corporation Public Company Limited, formerly Bangchak Petroleum, is a petroleum and energy conglomerate in Thailand. Founded as a state-owned company in 1984, it operates in oil refining, retail, and sustainable energy through subsidiaries.

byline-bank.name: Byline Bank
byline-bank.description: Byline Bank is a bank headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, United States. It is the primary subsidiary of Byline Bancorp, Inc., a bank holding company. Byline Bank is recognized as the fourth largest SBA 7(a) lender.

bank-of-nanjing.name: Bank of Nanjing
bank-of-nanjing.description: Bank of Nanjing is a Chinese joint-stock commercial bank founded in 1996 and headquartered in Nanjing, Jiangsu. Its largest single shareholder is BNP Paribas. The bank operates in the banking and fintech industry in China.

banco-pan.name: Banco Pan
