banco-pan.description: Banco Pan is a midsize commercial bank headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil. It focuses on consumer loans for lower to medium income individuals and offers credit cards, insurance, leasing, and group financial services.

banque-saudi-fransi.name: Banque Saudi Fransi
banque-saudi-fransi.description: Banque Saudi Fransi is a Saudi Arabian bank established by Royal Decree No. M/23 in June 1977. It operates in the financial services sector and is based in Saudi Arabia.

belo.name: Belo
belo.description: Belo Corporation was a Dallas, Texas-based media company owning 20 commercial broadcasting television stations and three regional 24-hour cable news channels. It formerly owned seven newspapers spun off into DallasNews Corporation. The company was headquartered in the Belo Building in Downtown Dallas.

bpost.name: bpost
bpost.description: Bpost is the Belgian company responsible for mail delivery in Belgium and is part of the Belgian Post Group. It offers postal, courier, direct marketing, banking, insurance, and electronic services. Its headquarters are located in Brussels at the Monnaie Center.

beijing-north-star.name: Beijing North Star
beijing-north-star.description: Beijing North Star Company Limited is a state-owned conglomerate enterprise based in Beijing, China. It engages in property management, property development, and retailing, with shares listed on the Hong Kong and Shanghai Stock Exchanges.

bucyrus-international.name: Bucyrus International
bucyrus-international.description: Bucyrus International, originally Bucyrus-Erie, was an American mining equipment company founded in 1880 in Ohio. It moved headquarters to Wisconsin in 1893 and merged with Erie Steam Shovel Company in 1927. The company was acquired by Caterpillar in 2011.

bank-of-ayudhya.name: Bank of Ayudhya
bank-of-ayudhya.description: Bank of Ayudhya Public Company Limited, branded as Krungsri, is the fifth-largest bank in Thailand by assets, loans, and deposits. It is one of Thailand's six Domestic Systemically Important Banks and is a member of the Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group.

broadspectrum.name: Broadspectrum
broadspectrum.description: Broadspectrum was an Australian and New Zealand company providing infrastructure maintenance services. Formerly listed on the Australian Securities Exchange, it was owned by Ferrovial before being acquired by Ventia. Ventia integrated Broadspectrum alongside Visionstream.

bea-systems.name: BEA Systems
bea-systems.description: BEA Systems, Inc. was a company specializing in enterprise infrastructure software products. It was wholly acquired by Oracle Corporation on April 29, 2008.

bta-bank.name: BTA Bank
bta-bank.description: BTA Bank is a Kazakhstan-based bank headquartered in Almaty. It was the third largest lender by assets as of 2013. In 2009, the bank was involved in one of the world's biggest financial frauds totaling US$5 billion.

babcock-wilcox.name: Babcock & Wilcox
babcock-wilcox.description: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises, Inc. is an American energy technology and service provider headquartered in Akron, Ohio. The company operates internationally and is historically known for its steam boilers.

bahnhof.name: Bahnhof
bahnhof.description: Bahnhof is a Swedish Internet service provider founded in 1994 by Oscar Swartz in Uppsala, Sweden. It was the country's first independent ISP and is now represented in multiple Swedish cities. The company is listed on Nasdaq First North.

baltona.name: Baltona
baltona.description: Baltona is a Polish company primarily operating in the duty-free market both in Poland and internationally. It focuses on retailing duty-free goods. The company is based in Poland and serves the retail sector.

bper-banca.name: BPER Banca
bper-banca.description: BPER Banca S.p.A., formerly Banca Popolare dell'Emilia Romagna S.C., is an Italian banking group headquartered in Modena. It offers traditional banking services to individuals, corporations, and public entities and is directly supervised by the European Central Bank. The bank holds shares in several regional banks and is part of the FTSE MIB index.

bangkok-bank.name: Bangkok Bank
bangkok-bank.description: Bangkok Bank is one of Thailand's largest commercial banks with over 800 branches domestically and 32 international branches in 15 economies. It has wholly owned subsidiaries in Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, and China, and branches in London and New York.

bangkok-airways.name: Bangkok Airways
bangkok-airways.description: Bangkok Airways is a regional airline headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. It operates scheduled flights to destinations in Thailand and neighboring countries, with its main base at Suvarnabhumi Airport in Bangkok.

bank-mandiri.name: Bank Mandiri
bank-mandiri.description: Bank Mandiri, headquartered in Jakarta, is Indonesia's largest bank by assets, loans, and deposits. It has held this position since at least 2014 and remains the largest bank in Indonesia as of 2022.

bank-of-east-asia.name: Bank of East Asia
bank-of-east-asia.description: The Bank of East Asia Limited is a public banking and financial services company headquartered in Central, Hong Kong. It is the largest independent local bank in Hong Kong and one of the two remaining family-run banks there. The bank continues to be managed by the 3rd and 4th generations of the Li family.

bank-of-communications.name: Bank of Communications
bank-of-communications.description: Bank of Communications is a Chinese multinational banking and financial services corporation established in 1908. It was one of the few domestic Chinese banks that issued banknotes in modern history. After 1949, its mainland operations merged into the People's Bank of China and People's Construction Bank of China, while its continuation in Taiwan became part of Mega International Commercial Bank.

bankia.name: Bankia
bankia.description: Bankia was a Spanish financial services company formed in 2010 by consolidating seven regional savings banks. It was partially nationalized in 2012 due to financial difficulties. In 2021, Bankia merged with CaixaBank to create a new entity initially preserving the Bankia name.

banorte.name: Banorte
banorte.description: Grupo Financiero Banorte, doing business as Banorte and Ixe, is a Mexican banking and financial services holding company headquartered in Monterrey and Mexico City. It is one of the four largest commercial banks in Mexico by assets and loans and the largest retirement fund administrator (AFORE).

bath-body-works.name: Bath & Body Works
bath-body-works.description: Bath & Body Works, LLC is an American retail chain selling soaps, lotions, fragrances, candles, accessories, and hand sanitizers. Founded in 1990 in New Albany, Ohio, it has expanded across six continents. In 1997, it became the largest bath shop chain in the United States.

becton-dickinson.name: Becton Dickinson
becton-dickinson.hq: Becton, Dickinson and Company headquarters, United States
becton-dickinson.description: Becton, Dickinson and Company is an American multinational medical technology company that manufactures and sells medical devices, instrument systems, and reagents. It also provides consulting and analytics services in certain areas.

bekaert.name: Bekaert
bekaert.industry: Forging, pressing, stamping and roll-forming of metal; powder metallurgy
bekaert.description: N.V. Bekaert S.A. is a global company headquartered in Belgium, specializing in steel wire transformation and coatings. It operates in 45 countries and employs 28,000 people worldwide.

belden-incorporated.name: Belden Incorporated
belden-incorporated.description: Belden Inc. is an American multinational company headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. It designs, manufactures, and distributes networking, connectivity, cable, and security products serving industrial automation, enterprise, smart-building, and broadband markets.

bemis-company.name: Bemis Company
bemis-company.description: Bemis Company, Inc. was a global manufacturer of flexible packaging products and pressure-sensitive materials. Headquartered in Neenah, Wisconsin, it had divisions in 12 countries and distributed its packaging films and adhesive materials worldwide.

beijing-enterprises.name: Beijing Enterprises
beijing-enterprises.description: Beijing Enterprises Holdings Limited is a Chinese investment company formed with eight units of assets located in Beijing, China.

bakkt.name: Bakkt
bakkt.description: Bakkt Holdings, Inc. is a United States-based company providing a software as a service (SaaS) and API platform for owning and trading cryptocurrency. It also facilitates fiat-to-stablecoin conversion and is organized in Delaware with principal executive offices in New York City.

bharat-heavy-electricals-limited.name: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited
bharat-heavy-electricals-limited.description: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) is an Indian state-owned engineering and manufacturing company headquartered in New Delhi. It operates under the Ministry of Heavy Industries and produces equipment for power generation, transmission, transportation, defence, aerospace, oil and gas, and emerging energy technologies.

billabong.name: Billabong
billabong.description: Billabong International Limited is an Australian company specializing in surfing-related products, primarily clothing and accessories. Founded in 1973, it owns several brands including Von Zipper and Element. In 2018, it was acquired by Boardriders, Inc, owner of Quiksilver.

biogen.name: Biogen
biogen.description: Biogen Inc. is an American multinational biotechnology company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. It specializes in treatments for neurological diseases and produces several drugs for multiple sclerosis, spinal muscular atrophy, and other conditions. The company collaborates with Genentech on several drugs.

bunzl-plc.name: Bunzl plc
bunzl-plc.description: Bunzl Public Limited Company is a British multinational distribution and outsourcing company headquartered in London, England. It operates in the paper and publishing industry. The company is notable for its multinational presence and outsourcing services.

bojangles-famous-chicken-n-biscuits.name: Bojangles' Famous Chicken 'n Biscuits
bojangles-famous-chicken-n-biscuits.description: Bojangles OpCo, LLC., doing business as Bojangles, is an American regional fast food chain specializing in Cajun-seasoned fried chicken and buttermilk biscuits. It primarily serves the Southeastern United States and was founded in Charlotte, North Carolina in 1977.

booz-allen-hamilton.name: Booz Allen Hamilton
booz-allen-hamilton.description: Booz Allen Hamilton Holding Corporation is an American government and military contractor specializing in intelligence, technology, and cybersecurity. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, it provides consulting, analysis, and engineering services to public- and private-sector organizations and nonprofits. The company has 80 additional offices worldwide.

boston-beer-company.name: Boston Beer Company
boston-beer-company.description: The Boston Beer Company is an American brewery founded in 1984 by James Koch and Rhonda Kallman. Its first brand was Samuel Adams, named after the American revolutionary patriot. The company has expanded to several other brands and merged with Dogfish Head Brewery in 2019.

bouygues.name: Bouygues
bouygues.description: Bouygues S.A. is a French engineering group headquartered in Paris. It specializes in construction, real estate development, media, and telecommunications. The company is listed on the Euronext Paris exchange and is part of the CAC 40 stock market index.

brf.name: BRF
brf.description: BRF S.A. is a Brazilian food processing company with over 30 brands including Sadia and Perdigão. Its products are marketed in more than 150 countries across five continents. The company employs over 100,000 people and operates about 50 production facilities in eight countries.

brasil-telecom.name: Brasil Telecom
brasil-telecom.description: Brasil Telecom S.A. was a major Brazilian telecommunications company headquartered in Brasília. It emerged after the break-up of Telebrás and provided landline, mobile, and long-distance services in central and southern Brazil. Since 2009, it has been a subsidiary of Oi.

brookfield-corporation.name: Brookfield Corporation
brookfield-corporation.description: Brookfield Corporation is a Canadian multinational alternative investment management company headquartered in Toronto. It manages over US$1 trillion in assets, focusing on real estate, renewable power, infrastructure, credit, and private equity.

briggs-stratton.name: Briggs & Stratton
briggs-stratton.description: Briggs & Stratton Corporation is an American manufacturer of small engines headquartered in Wauwatosa, Wisconsin. The company specializes in mechanical engineering products.

brinker-international.name: Brinker International
brinker-international.description: Brinker International, Inc. is an American multinational hospitality company based in Dallas, Texas. It owns and operates restaurant chains including Chili's Grill & Bar and Maggiano's Little Italy worldwide.

british-land.name: British Land
british-land.description: The British Land Company Plc is one of the largest property development and investment companies in the United Kingdom. Headquartered in London, it became a real estate investment trust in 2007 and is a founding member of the European Public Real Estate Association.

bank-jtrust-indonesia.name: Bank JTrust Indonesia
bank-jtrust-indonesia.description: PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk is an Indonesian bank founded in 2015. The bank is based in Jakarta and operates in the banking sector.

banco-alfa.name: Banco Alfa
banco-alfa.description: Alfa Bank is a Brazilian commercial bank based in São Paulo. The bank's president is Aloysio de Andrade Faria. It operates within the financial sector in Brazil.

bombril.name: Bombril
bombril.description: Bombril is a Brazilian manufacturer of household cleaning agents, best known for its fine-grade steel wool product marketed under the brand "Bom Bril." The company once held a 90% share of the Brazilian market for steel wool, and its brand name is commonly used as a metonym for steel wool in Brazil.

baic-bluepark.name: BAIC BluePark
baic-bluepark.description: BAIC BluePark is a subsidiary of BAIC Group focused on the design, research, development, and sales of electric automobiles. It was restructured from Beijing Electric Vehicle Co., Ltd. and operates brands including Stelato, Arcfox, and EV models under the Beijing brand.

brother-industries.name: Brother Industries
brother-industries.description: Brother Industries, Ltd. is a Japanese multinational electronics and electrical equipment company headquartered in Nagoya, Japan. It produces printers, sewing machines, typewriters, fax machines, and other computer-related electronics, distributing products under its own name and OEM agreements.

brunswick-corporation.name: Brunswick Corporation
brunswick-corporation.description: Brunswick Corporation is an American company headquartered in Mettawa, Illinois, that has developed, manufactured, and sold a wide variety of products since 1845. It operates in 24 countries and owns brands including Mercury Marine.

broderbund.name: Broderbund
broderbund.description: Broderbund Software, Inc. was an American maker of video games, educational software, and productivity tools. Founded in Eugene, Oregon, it is known for titles like Prince of Persia and Myst. The company was acquired by The Learning Company in 1998.

bank-of-the-northeast.name: Bank of the Northeast
bank-of-the-northeast.description: Banco do Nordeste is a Brazilian regional development bank headquartered in Fortaleza, Ceará. Founded in 1952, it has 300 branches and operates in about 2000 cities across the Northeast region of Brazil and parts of the North region.

bollore.name: Bolloré
bollore.industry: Manufacture of plates, sheets, tubes and profiles in plastic materials
bollore.description: Bolloré S.E. is a French conglomerate headquartered in Puteaux, near Paris. Founded in 1822, it started in fine paper and plastic film and later diversified into freight transport, oil storage, batteries, access control, palm oil, rubber, olive groves, and wine production. It also expanded into advertising, media, and communications.

bashkirenergo.name: Bashkirenergo
bashkirenergo.description: OJSC Bashkirenergo was a power and heat company operating in Bashkortostan, Russia. Its major shareholder was the holding company Sistema, with 21.27% of shares owned by the Russian grid company FGC UES. The company operated in the utilities sector.

banque-misr.name: Banque Misr
banque-misr.description: Banque Misr S.A.E. is a major Egyptian bank and one of Egypt's big five banks. Founded in 1920, it has branch offices across all Egyptian governorates and provides currency exchange and work permit offices for foreign workers. The bank was nationalized by the United Arab Republic government in 1960.

bank-of-bogota.name: Bank of Bogota
bank-of-bogota.description: Banco de Bogotá is a Colombian bank and the first commercial bank established in Colombia. It is one of the Big Four banks in the country.

bradesco-seguros.name: Bradesco Seguros
bradesco-seguros.description: Bradesco Seguros is the largest insurance company in Brazil and Latin America, created in 1983 after Banco Bradesco acquired Atlântica Boavista de Seguros. The company is headquartered in Barueri, São Paulo, and operates in the financial services sector.

bank-of-georgia.name: Bank of Georgia
bank-of-georgia.description: Bank of Georgia JSC is a universal bank and financial services company founded in 1994. It is headquartered in Tbilisi, Georgia, and received its banking license from the National Bank of Georgia in December 1994.

banco-de-seguros-del-estado.name: Banco de Seguros del Estado
banco-de-seguros-del-estado.description: The State Insurance Bank is a government-owned insurance company in Uruguay. Established in 1911, it operates under the Ministry of Economy and Finance and functions as an autonomous state entity.

bmobile.name: bmobile
bmobile.hq: Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
bmobile.description: bmobile is a mobile phone, home security, and fixed wireless provider based in Trinidad and Tobago. It operates as a division of TSTT. The company offers various telecommunications services within the country.

boliviana-de-aviacion.name: Boliviana de Aviación
boliviana-de-aviacion.description: Boliviana de Aviación, stylized as BoA, is the flag carrier airline of Bolivia and is wholly owned by the government. Founded in October 2007 and headquartered in Cochabamba, it operates domestic flights mainly from Jorge Wilstermann International Airport and international flights from Viru Viru International Airport.

bob-s.name: Bob's
bob-s.description: Bob's is a Brazilian fast food chain founded in 1952 by American Brazilian tennis champion Bob Falkenburg. The first store opened in the Copacabana neighborhood of Rio de Janeiro. It is recognized as the first Brazilian fast food chain.

botswana-telecommunications-corporation.name: Botswana Telecommunications Corporation
botswana-telecommunications-corporation.description: Botswana Telecommunications Corporation (BTC) is a converged telecommunications operator in Botswana, established in 1980 as a 100% government-owned entity. It offers fixed, mobile, broadband, cloud, and fintech services.

bionor-pharma.name: Bionor Pharma
bionor-pharma.description: Bionor Holding AS is a Norwegian biotechnology company developing vaccines for rapidly mutating viruses such as HIV, Hepatitis C, and Influenza. It also leads in soy technology with patented health products and was founded by Lars Høie.

billions.name: BILLIONS
billions.description: Billions is a South Korean entertainment agency and film and drama production company. In June 2024, the company changed its name from Blade Entertainment to Billions. It operates in the entertainment industry.

blom.name: Blom
blom.description: Blom is a European service provider headquartered in Oslo, Norway, specializing in acquisition, processing, and modeling of geographical information. It maintains European databases of maps, images, and models, focusing on online services for government, enterprise, and consumer markets. Blom is a subsidiary of NRC Group, listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.

beowulf-mining.name: Beowulf Mining
beowulf-mining.description: Beowulf Mining plc is a UK-registered exploration and development company focused on the Nordic region. It operates subsidiaries involved in open-pit mining in Sweden and Finland. The company was formed in 1988 and is listed on the AIM in London and Spotlight in Sweden.

bisichi-mining.name: Bisichi Mining
bisichi-mining.description: Bisichi PLC is a mining and property corporation based in the United Kingdom and listed on the London Stock Exchange. Founded in 1910, it operates the Black Wattle coal mine in South Africa and manages retail property investments through London & Associated Properties.

bridgepoint-group-plc.name: Bridgepoint Group plc
bridgepoint-group-plc.description: Bridgepoint Group plc is a British private investment company listed on the London Stock Exchange as a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. It operates in the investment sector and is based in the United Kingdom.

bank-saderat-iran.name: Bank Saderat Iran
bank-saderat-iran.description: Bank Saderat Iran is an Iranian multinational banking and financial services company headquartered in Tehran. Founded in 1952 by the Mofarrah and Bolurfrushan families, it is Iran's largest bank. The bank started operations with a board of three directors and 20 employees.

bank-sepah.name: Bank Sepah
bank-sepah.description: Bank Sepah is a major Iranian bank headquartered in Tehran with historical links to the country's military community. Established in 1925 as the first modern domestic Iranian bank, it is owned by the Iranian government and serves as a financial platform for the Ministry of Defence and Armed Forces Logistics.

boralex.name: Boralex
boralex.description: Boralex is a Canadian energy production company founded in 1990 in Quebec. It develops, builds, and operates renewable energy facilities in Canada, France, the UK, and the US. Boralex is recognized as a leading independent producer of onshore wind energy in France and operates in the utilities sector.

bat-brasil.name: BAT Brasil
bat-brasil.description: Souza Cruz S.A., known as BAT Brasil, is a Brazilian tobacco manufacturer based in Rio de Janeiro. Founded in 1903, it became a subsidiary of British American Tobacco after transferring controlling interest in 1914.

borregaard.name: Borregaard
borregaard.description: Borregaard is a Norwegian company founded in 1889 in Sarpsborg. Initially producing pulp and paper, it later specialized in chemicals based on timber. It was part of the Orkla Group until its 2012 spin-off and listing on the Oslo Stock Exchange.

bbva-peru.name: BBVA Peru
bbva-peru.description: BBVA Perú is a Peruvian bank and a subsidiary of Holding Continental, which holds 92.08% of its equity. It operates in the banking sector in Peru.

baillie-gifford-shin-nippon.name: Baillie Gifford Shin Nippon
baillie-gifford-shin-nippon.description: Baillie Gifford Shin Nippon is a publicly traded investment trust based in the United Kingdom. It invests in Japanese smaller companies and is managed by Edinburgh-based Baillie Gifford & Co Limited.

banco-cruzeiro-do-sul.name: Banco Cruzeiro do Sul
banco-cruzeiro-do-sul.description: Banco Cruzeiro do Sul was a Brazil-based bank focused on consumer financing. The bank was declared bankrupt on August 11, 2015.

bankatlantic.name: BankAtlantic
bankatlantic.description: BankAtlantic was a US bank operating in Florida until its acquisition by BB&T Corporation in 2012. It provided consumer and business banking services throughout Florida.

bank-maskan.name: Bank Maskan
bank-maskan.description: Bank Maskan, also known as the Housing Bank, is a bank based in Iran.

bank-mellat.name: Bank Mellat
bank-mellat.description: Bank Mellat is an active Iranian bank established in 1980 through the merger of ten private banks. Its name means 'Bank of the Nation' and it started with a paid capital of 33.5 billion Rials.

bank-ochrony-srodowiska.name: Bank Ochrony Środowiska
bank-ochrony-srodowiska.description: Bank Ochrony Środowiska S.A. is a Polish bank that started operations in 1991. It specializes in financing projects that contribute to environmental protection. The bank has allocated significant funds to support ecological projects, resulting in notable environmental impacts.

bank-pasargad.name: Bank Pasargad
bank-pasargad.description: Bank Pasargad is a major Iranian bank established in 2005 during the privatization of Iran's banking system. It offers retail, commercial, and investment banking services. The bank is also known by the acronym BPI.

bankers-petroleum.name: Bankers Petroleum
bankers-petroleum.description: Bankers Petroleum Albania Ltd. is the dominant oil operator in Albania and a subsidiary of China's Geo-Jade Petroleum. It operates the Patos-Marinza oil field, the largest in Albania and one of the largest onshore fields in Europe. The company produces 95% of Albania's crude oil.

banmedica.name: Banmédica
banmedica.description: Banmédica is a private health insurance company based in Chile. It operates in the health sector providing insurance services.

banner-bank.name: Banner Bank
banner-bank.description: Banner Bank is a commercial bank chartered in Washington, United States. Founded in 1890, it is headquartered in Walla Walla, Washington.

beacon-power.name: Beacon Power
beacon-power.description: Beacon Power, LLC is an American company headquartered in Tyngsboro, Massachusetts, specializing in flywheel-based energy storage. Founded in 1997, it is a wholly owned subsidiary of RGA Investments LLC and designs products for utility frequency regulation in power grid operations.

behran-oil-company.name: Behran Oil Company
behran-oil-company.description: Behran Oil Company is an oil refining company headquartered in Tehran, Iran. It exports its products to more than 40 countries.

bellway.name: Bellway
bellway.description: Bellway plc is a residential property developer and housebuilder based in Newcastle upon Tyne, England. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

bennett-environmental.name: Bennett Environmental
bennett-environmental.description: Bennett Environmental Inc. was a Canadian company based in Oakville, Ontario. It specialized in recovering soils contaminated with chlorinated hydrocarbons, including PCBs, PCPs, dioxins, and furans.

big-rock-brewery.name: Big Rock Brewery
big-rock-brewery.description: Big Rock Brewery is a Canadian public company and the largest brewery based in Calgary, Alberta. It is also Canada's largest craft brewery and distributes a variety of beers and ciders nationwide.

big-yellow-group.name: Big Yellow Group
big-yellow-group.description: Big Yellow Group plc is a self-storage company headquartered in Bagshot, England. It is the largest self-storage firm in the UK and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

blue-bird-corporation.name: Blue Bird Corporation
blue-bird-corporation.description: The Blue Bird Corporation is an American bus manufacturer headquartered in Fort Valley, Georgia. It is best known for producing school buses and has also manufactured transit buses, motorhomes, and specialty vehicles like mobile libraries and police command centers.

boardwalk-real-estate-investment-trust.name: Boardwalk Real Estate Investment Trust
boardwalk-real-estate-investment-trust.description: Boardwalk Real Estate Investment Trust is an open-ended real estate investment trust that owns Boardwalk Communities, Structures Metropolitaines, and Boardwalk Retirement Community. It operates in Canada.

bonheur.name: Bonheur
bonheur.description: Bonheur ASA is a publicly traded Norwegian holding company headquartered in Oslo. It is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange and has interests in energy, real estate, shipping, and media sectors. Its largest divisions include Renewable Energy, Wind Service, and Cruise.

booker-group.name: Booker Group
booker-group.description: Booker Group Limited is a British wholesale distributor and a subsidiary of Tesco PLC. Tesco purchased the company in 2018.

bovis-homes-group.name: Bovis Homes Group
bovis-homes-group.description: Vistry Group PLC, formerly Bovis Homes Group PLC, is a British home construction company based in Kings Hill, England. It acquired Galliford Try's housing arm in 2020 and renamed the combined business Vistry. It is one of the biggest housebuilders in the UK.

british-energy.name: British Energy
british-energy.description: British Energy was the UK's largest electricity generation company by volume before its 2009 takeover by Électricité de France (EDF). It operated eight former UK state-owned nuclear power stations and one coal-fired power station.

brewin-dolphin.name: Brewin Dolphin
brewin-dolphin.description: RBC Brewin Dolphin is a British wealth management firm with over 30 offices across the UK, Jersey, and Ireland. It provides investment management and financial planning services to individuals, companies, intermediaries, and charities.

britvic.name: Britvic
britvic.description: Britvic Limited is a British soft drinks producer based in Hemel Hempstead, Hertfordshire. It produces soft drinks under the Britvic name, including Britvic Orange and other brands. The company originated in the 1930s as the British Vitamin Products Company and became part of Allied Breweries in 1968.

buhler-industries.name: Buhler Industries
buhler-industries.description: Buhler Industries, Inc. is a Canadian company headquartered in Winnipeg, Manitoba, manufacturing machinery for farms and construction. It operates eight factories across Canada and the United States.

bank-day.name: Bank Day
bank-day.description: Bank Day is a non-state owned Iranian bank established in 2010. It operates under the guidelines and instructions of the Central Bank of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

bauer-hockey.name: Bauer Hockey
bauer-hockey.description: Bauer Hockey LLC is a North American manufacturer of ice hockey equipment, fitness and recreational skates, and apparel. Its products include helmets, gloves, sticks, skates, and protective gear. Some of its ice hockey skates are approved for use in ringette.

bank-bph.name: Bank BPH
bank-bph.description: Bank BPH was a bank based in Kraków, Poland, established in 1988-1989 by spinoff from the National Bank of Poland. It merged with Bank PBK in 2001 and was later dismantled, with operations taken over by Bank Pekao and Alior Bank.

billerud.name: Billerud
billerud.description: Verso Corporation, now Billerud Americas Corporation, was an American producer of coated papers including coated groundwood and specialty products. The company restructured in 2016 following Chapter 11 bankruptcy and operated two paper mills in the U.S.

btg.name: BTG
btg.description: BTG Limited is a UK-based international specialist healthcare company developing and commercializing products targeting critical care, cancer, and other disorders. It adopted its current name in 1998 after changing from British Technology Group. BTG was part of the FTSE 250 Index until its acquisition by Boston Scientific in 2019.

balfour-beatty.name: Balfour Beatty
balfour-beatty.description: Balfour Beatty plc is an international infrastructure group based in the United Kingdom. It provides construction services, support services, and infrastructure investments, operating across the UK, US, and Hong Kong. It was ranked as the biggest construction contractor in the UK by turnover in 2021.

banca-rasini.name: Banca Rasini
banca-rasini.description: Banca Rasini was an Italian bank based in Milan, founded in the 1950s and acquired by Banca Popolare di Lodi in 1992. Notably, it had customers such as Pippo Calò, Totò Riina, Bernardo Provenzano, and Silvio Berlusconi, with Silvio's father Luigi Berlusconi employed there. The bank operated in the financial services sector.

bank-melli-iran.name: Bank Melli Iran
bank-melli-iran.description: Bank Melli Iran is a leading commercial bank based in Tehran, Iran. Established in 1928, it served as Iran's central bank until 1960 before becoming a commercial bank.

bank-of-industry-and-mine.name: Bank of Industry and Mine
bank-of-industry-and-mine.description: Bank of Industry and Mine is a government-owned specialized bank in Tehran, Iran. It focuses on promoting economic growth through the development of industry and mining sectors.

bidvest-group.name: Bidvest Group
bidvest-group.description: Bidvest Group is a South African multinational services, trading, and distribution company headquartered in Johannesburg, Gauteng. Founded in 1988 and listed on the JSE, it operates over 250 businesses across multiple countries including South Africa, Australia, Singapore, Spain, Ireland, and the United Kingdom.

british-airways.name: British Airways
british-airways.description: British Airways plc is the flag carrier airline of the United Kingdom, based in London, England. It is headquartered at the Waterside building near its main hub at Heathrow Airport. The company operates as a major airline in the UK.

bodycote.name: Bodycote
bodycote.description: Bodycote plc is a supplier of heat treatments, metal joining, hot isostatic pressing, and coating services. It is based in Macclesfield, United Kingdom, and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

boliden-ab.name: Boliden AB
boliden-ab.description: Boliden AB is a Swedish multinational metals, mining, and smelting company headquartered in Stockholm. It produces zinc, copper, lead, nickel, silver, and gold, with operations in several European countries including Sweden, Finland, and Norway.

bombardier-recreational-products.name: Bombardier Recreational Products
bombardier-recreational-products.description: BRP Inc. is a Canadian manufacturer of snowmobiles, all-terrain vehicles, motorcycles, and personal watercraft. It was founded in 2003 after being spun off from Bombardier Inc., which was originally founded in 1942 in Quebec.

borovo.name: Borovo
borovo.description: Borovo is a Croatian shoe manufacturer founded in 1931 in the village of Borovo near Vukovar. It gained significant success during the time of SFR Yugoslavia, known especially for its Borosana shoes. The company operates in the footwear industry.

boston-pizza.name: Boston Pizza
boston-pizza.description: Boston Pizza International Inc. is a Canadian multinational restaurant chain that owns and franchises locations in Canada, the United States, and Mexico. It operates in the system catering industry.

bbi-development-nfi-sa.name: BBI Development NFI SA
bbi-development-nfi-sa.description: BBI Development NFI SA is a joint-stock company listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange that focuses on the real estate market in Warsaw, Poland.

bank-gospodarki-zywnosciowej.name: Bank Gospodarki Żywnościowej
bank-gospodarki-zywnosciowej.description: Bank Gospodarki Żywnościowej, known as BGZ Bank, was a significant bank based in Warsaw, Poland.

bedzin-power-station.name: Będzin Power Station
bedzin-power-station.description: Będzin Power Station is a cogeneration plant located in Będzin, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland.

bourse-regionale-des-valeurs-mobilieres.name: Bourse Regionale Des Valeurs Mobilieres
bourse-regionale-des-valeurs-mobilieres.description: The Bourse Régionale des Valeurs Mobilières (BRVM) is a regional stock exchange serving eight West African countries including Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, and Mali.

boissons-du-cameroun.name: Boissons du Cameroun
boissons-du-cameroun.description: Les Sociétés Anonymes des Brasseries du Cameroun is a brewing company with offices and a main factory in Douala, Cameroon. It has additional breweries in Bafoussam, Douala, Garoua, and Yaoundé. The company is majority-owned by Les Brasseries et Glacieres Internationales (BGI) and partly by Heineken.

banco-cabo-verdiano-de-negocios.name: Banco Cabo-Verdiano de Negócios
banco-cabo-verdiano-de-negocios.description: Banco Cabo-Verdiano de Negócios is a commercial bank based in Praia, Cape Verde. Its headquarters are located on Avenida Amílcar Cabral. Luís Vasconcelos Lopes is the current president of its board of directors.

buraq-air.name: Buraq Air
buraq-air.description: Buraq Air is an airline headquartered at Mitiga International Airport in Tripoli, Libya. It operates a minor international scheduled network, charter services, and flights supporting CHC. The airline's base is Mitiga International Airport, and its Chairman and CEO is Captain Mohamed Bubeida, who is also an active pilot.

bank-of-africa.name: Bank of Africa
bank-of-africa.description: Bank of Africa, formerly Banque Marocaine du Commerce Extérieur, is a Moroccan international financial services group. It is headquartered in Casablanca and provides a range of financial services internationally.

bcp-group.name: BCP Group
bcp-group.description: BCP Group, also known as Banque Populaire or Chaabi, is a Moroccan international financial services group. It is headquartered at the BCP Tower in Casablanca and offers various banking services.

banco-nacional-de-investimento.name: Banco Nacional de Investimento
banco-nacional-de-investimento.description: Banco Nacional de Investimento is a Mozambican state-owned development bank associated with the Ministry of Finance. It provides long-term financing for sustainable projects contributing to social and economic development in sectors like infrastructure, energy, agriculture, and transportation.

bank-windhoek.name: Bank Windhoek
bank-windhoek.description: Bank Windhoek Limited is a commercial bank licensed by the Bank of Namibia. It offers financial services including personal, commercial, and SME banking within Namibia.

bank-bic-namibia-limited.name: Bank BIC Namibia Limited
bank-bic-namibia-limited.description: Bank BIC Namibia Limited is a commercial bank licensed to operate in Namibia. It is a subsidiary of the Bank BIC Group, a financial services conglomerate based in Angola with subsidiaries in several countries.

babban-gona.name: Babban Gona
babban-gona.description: Babban Gona is a social enterprise in Nigeria that supports smallholder farmers to increase their profitability. Its name means "Great Farm" in Hausa.

bank-of-africa-uganda.name: Bank of Africa
bank-of-africa-uganda.description: Bank of Africa Uganda Limited (BOA Uganda) is a commercial bank licensed by the Bank of Uganda, the country's central bank and banking regulator.

bar-aviation-uganda.name: BAR Aviation Uganda
bar-aviation-uganda.description: BAR Aviation Uganda is an aviation company based in Uganda offering charter services, pilot training, air ambulance services, and aircraft maintenance. Its main base is Entebbe International Airport, with a second hub at Kajjansi Airport in Wakiso District.

banque-populaire-du-rwanda.name: Banque Populaire du Rwanda
banque-populaire-du-rwanda.description: BPR Bank Rwanda, formerly Banque Populaire du Rwanda SA, is a commercial bank licensed by the National Bank of Rwanda. It operates in Rwanda's financial services sector providing banking services.

bralirwa.name: Bralirwa
bralirwa.description: Bralirwa, also known as Brasseries et Limonaderies du Rwanda, is the largest brewer and soft beverage company in Rwanda. It is publicly traded on the Rwanda Stock Exchange and produces a variety of beverages.

banco-internacional-de-sao-tome-e-princi.name: Banco Internacional de São Tomé e Príncipe
banco-internacional-de-sao-tome-e-princi.legal_name: Banco Internacional de São Tomé e Príncipe
banco-internacional-de-sao-tome-e-princi.hq: São Tomé, São Tomé and Príncipe
banco-internacional-de-sao-tome-e-princi.description: Banco Internacional de São Tomé e Príncipe (BISTP) is the largest and oldest commercial bank in São Tomé and Príncipe. It has a head office and 14 branches. The bank's name translates to International Bank of São Tomé and Príncipe.

bank-of-west-africa.name: Bank of West Africa
bank-of-west-africa.description: The Bank of West Africa, formerly known as Banque du Sénégal and Banque internationale pour l'Afrique occidentale (BIAO), was headquartered in Dakar. It was the main or only commercial bank and bank of issue in French Senegal and French West Africa for most of its history.

bank-balad.name: Bank Balad
bank-balad.description: Bank Balad, originally founded as Al Shamal Islamic Bank in 1983, is a major financial institution in Sudan. It rebranded to Balad Bank in 2018 and is recognized as one of the leading Islamic banks worldwide.

bluebird-aviation.name: Bluebird Aviation
bluebird-aviation.description: Bluebird Aviation is a regional airline based in Nairobi, Kenya, established in 1992. It operates regional charter services with its main base at Wilson Airport in Nairobi.

brasil-paralelo.name: Brasil Paralelo
brasil-paralelo.description: Brasil Paralelo is a Brazilian media company founded in Porto Alegre and headquartered in São Paulo since 2020. It produces documentaries offering alternative viewpoints on politics, history, and current events, distributing content primarily through its subscription streaming platform and YouTube channel.

brazilian-development-bank.name: Brazilian Development Bank
brazilian-development-bank.description: The National Bank for Economic and Social Development (BNDES) is a Brazilian development bank structured as a federal public company linked to the Ministry of the Economy. It provides long-term financing to projects that contribute to Brazil's development. BNDES is one of the largest development banks globally.

big-bompreco.name: BIG Bompreço
big-bompreco.description: Bompreço was a chain of supermarkets and hypermarkets in Brazil, with a name meaning "good price" in Portuguese. As of 2022, Bompreço is owned by Carrefour Brazil. The company operated in the retail sector.

banco-bv.name: Banco BV
banco-bv.description: Banco BV is the seventh largest bank in Brazil, founded in 1988 and headquartered in São Paulo. It operates in wholesale, retail, treasury, asset management, and brokerage sectors.

buscape.name: Buscapé
buscape.description: Buscapé is a Latin American comparison shopping service co-founded in São Paulo, Brazil in 1999 by Romero Rodrigues and others.

brazilian-red-cross.name: Brazilian Red Cross
brazilian-red-cross.description: The Brazilian Red Cross was founded in 1908 and has its headquarters in Brasília. It operates as a humanitarian organization in Brazil.

banco-real.name: Banco Real
banco-real.description: Banco Real was a Brazilian bank acquired by Spain's Banco Santander after a consortium led by Royal Bank of Scotland acquired ABN AMRO. Banco Santander integrated Banco Real with its Brazilian operations to become a major private bank in Brazil.

banco-safra.name: Banco Safra
banco-safra.description: Banco Safra is a Brazilian financial services company headquartered in São Paulo. It is the seventh largest banking institution in Brazil and the nineteenth largest in Latin America. The bank offers investment banking, private banking, asset management, and retail banking through its neobank AgZero.

baden-baden.name: Baden Baden
baden-baden.description: Baden Baden is a Brazilian microbrewery located in Campos do Jordão, São Paulo. Founded in 1999 as a model factory for craft beer production, it is now owned by Heineken. The company operates in the brewing industry.

banque-exterieure-d-algerie.name: Banque extérieure d'Algérie
banque-exterieure-d-algerie.description: Banque extérieure d'Algérie is a public bank established in 1967 and based in Bir Mourad Raïs, Algeria. It operates within the financial services sector in Algeria.

banco-ripley.name: Banco Ripley
banco-ripley.description: Banco Ripley is a bank operating in Chile. It provides banking services within the Chilean financial sector.

bank-of-london-and-south-america.name: Bank of London and South America
bank-of-london-and-south-america.legal_name: Bank of London and South America
bank-of-london-and-south-america.industry: Financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
bank-of-london-and-south-america.description: The Bank of London and South America Limited was a British bank operating in South America from 1923 to 1971. It provided financial services in the region including Chile.

banco-bice.name: Banco BICE
banco-bice.description: Banco BICE is a Chilean bank founded in 1979 and based in Santiago. It is controlled by the Matte family, with Bernardo Matte as president and Alberto Schilling Redlich as CEO.

bersa.name: Bersa
bersa.description: Bersa is an Argentine arms manufacturer located in the city of Ramos Mejía, Argentina. The company operates in the arms industry, producing firearms.

bridas-corporation.name: Bridas Corporation
bridas-corporation.description: Bridas Corporation is an Argentine independent oil and gas holding company based in Buenos Aires. Since March 2010, it has been 50% owned by China National Offshore Oil Corporation. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

bank-of-the-argentine-nation.name: Bank of the Argentine Nation
bank-of-the-argentine-nation.description: Banco de la Nación Argentina is the largest bank in Argentina's banking sector. It operates as a financial institution within the country.

banco-credicoop.name: Banco Credicoop
banco-credicoop.description: Banco Credicoop is the largest cooperatively-owned bank in Argentina. It operates within the country's banking and financial sector.

bank-of-the-city-of-buenos-aires.name: Bank of the City of Buenos Aires
bank-of-the-city-of-buenos-aires.legal_name: Bank of the City of Buenos Aires
bank-of-the-city-of-buenos-aires.description: The Bank of the City of Buenos Aires, known as Banco Ciudad, is a publicly owned municipal commercial bank based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Founded in 1878 as Monte de Piedad, it aimed to combat usury by providing loans at below-market interest rates to reduce social inequalities.

bank-of-the-province-of-buenos-aires.name: Bank of the Province of Buenos Aires
bank-of-the-province-of-buenos-aires.legal_name: Bank of the Province of Buenos Aires
bank-of-the-province-of-buenos-aires.description: The Bank of the Province of Buenos Aires, or Banco Provincia, is a publicly owned bank in Argentina. It is recognized as the second-largest bank in the country by value of assets and deposits.

banco-hipotecario.name: Banco Hipotecario
banco-hipotecario.description: Banco Hipotecario S.A. is an Argentine financial institution with majority state participation. Founded in 1886 as Banco Hipotecario Nacional, its initial purpose was to grant mortgage loans for home construction.

baires-fly.name: Baires Fly
baires-fly.description: Baires Fly S.A. is an airline based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, established in 1996. It operates passenger and cargo charter services from its main base at Aeroparque Jorge Newbery. The airline was reported to be used in a notable flight involving Flávio Bolsonaro.

bembos.name: Bembos
bembos.description: Bembos is a Peruvian fast food restaurant chain founded in 1988 by Carlos Camino and Mirko Cermak. It is known for its hamburgers with Peruvian-influenced variations and distinctive restaurant architecture.

backus-and-johnston-brewery.name: Backus and Johnston Brewery
backus-and-johnston-brewery.description: Backus and Johnston is the largest brewery in Peru and part of the Bavaria Brewery, itself under the international AB InBev group. Its main brewery is located in the Ate District of Lima. The company produces beer, soft drinks, and bottled water, holding a near monopoly on Peruvian beer brands.

banco-industrial-de-venezuela.name: Banco Industrial de Venezuela
banco-industrial-de-venezuela.description: Banco Industrial de Venezuela, or BIV, was a Venezuelan state bank. It operated as a financial institution in Venezuela.

banco-digital-de-los-trabajadores.name: Banco Digital de los Trabajadores
banco-digital-de-los-trabajadores.description: BDT Banco Digital de los Trabajadores, Banco Universal C.A., is a bank based in Caracas, Venezuela. It was created in 2009 through a merger of several state-owned banks following a banking crisis. The bank holds around 20% of Venezuelan bank deposits.

bdv-banco-de-venezuela.name: BDV | Banco de Venezuela
bdv-banco-de-venezuela.description: Banco de Venezuela is an international universal bank based in Caracas. It was the market leader in Venezuela until 2007 and had 285 branches as of June 2008, competing with Banesco, Banco Mercantil, and BBVA Banco Provincial.

banco-occidental-de-descuento.name: Banco Occidental de Descuento
banco-occidental-de-descuento.description: Banco Occidental de Descuento (BOD) was a Venezuelan bank that held around 6.6% of the market, making it the fifth-largest bank in Venezuela in 2009.

banesco.name: Banesco
banesco.description: Banesco Banco Universal C.A. is a Venezuelan financial institution headquartered in Caracas. It operates as a bank and is a member of the Asociación Bancaria de Venezuela. The bank serves customers primarily within Venezuela.

bbva-provincial.name: BBVA Provincial
bbva-provincial.description: BBVA Provincial is a financial institution operating in Venezuela. It was formerly known as BBVA Banco Provincial. The bank provides various financial services within the country.

banco-venezolano-de-credito.name: Banco Venezolano de Crédito
banco-venezolano-de-credito.description: Banco Venezolano de Crédito is a Venezuelan bank based in Caracas, founded in 1925 as the oldest private bank in the country. It operates a network of branches across Venezuela and has an international branch in the Cayman Islands established in 1998.

blue-wing-airlines.name: Blue Wing Airlines
blue-wing-airlines.description: Blue Wing Airlines is a Surinamese airline headquartered at Zorg en Hoop Airport in Paramaribo. It operates charter and scheduled flights to destinations in Suriname's interior, Guyana, Brazil, Venezuela, and the Caribbean. The airline has been banned from operating in the European Union due to safety violations.

bolsa-de-valores-de-asuncion.name: Bolsa de Valores de Asunción
bolsa-de-valores-de-asuncion.description: The Bolsa de Valores de Asunción (BVA) is a stock exchange located in Asunción, the capital city of Paraguay. It serves as a financial market platform within Paraguay. The exchange facilitates securities trading in the country.

banco-itau-paraguay-s-a.name: Banco Itaú Paraguay S.A.
banco-itau-paraguay-s-a.description: Banco Itaú Paraguay S.A. is a financial institution in Paraguay founded in 1978 as Interbanco SA. It was acquired by Unibanco Group in 1995 and renamed Banco Itaú Paraguay S.A. in 2010 after a merger. It is considered the largest bank in Paraguay and appointed its first Paraguayan CEO in 2020.

banco-de-occidente.name: Banco de Occidente
banco-de-occidente.description: Banco de Occidente is one of the largest banks in Colombia and part of the Grupo Aval financial conglomerate. It is owned by Luis Carlos Sarmiento Angulo, a prominent Colombian financier.

bavaria-brewery.name: Bavaria Brewery
bavaria-brewery.description: Bavaria Brewery, founded in 1889 by German immigrant Leo S. Kopp, is a Colombian brewery company. It became a subsidiary of SABMiller in 2005 and was the second-largest brewery in South America before the merger.

busscar-de-colombia.name: Busscar de Colombia
busscar-de-colombia.description: Busscar de Colombia is a Colombian bus manufacturer headquartered in Pereira, Risaralda. It was a subsidiary of a parent company based in Joinville, Brazil.

banco-union.name: Banco Union
banco-union.description: Banco Unión S.A. is a Bolivian state bank based in La Paz. Founded on November 5, 1981, it is one of the country's main financial institutions.

bolivian-red-cross.name: Bolivian Red Cross
bolivian-red-cross.description: The Bolivian Red Cross is the national Red Cross society for Bolivia, affiliated with the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies. It was founded in La Paz by Juan Manuel Balcázar on May 15, 1917.

banred.name: Banred
banred.description: Banred is a network of automated teller machines in Uruguay with over 330 locations. It was formed by the merger of two separate ATM networks, RedBanc and Bancomat, in 2005.

banco-hipotecario-del-uruguay.name: Banco Hipotecario del Uruguay
banco-hipotecario-del-uruguay.description: The Mortgage Bank of Uruguay is a state-owned bank in Uruguay. It provides financial services related to mortgages within the country.

bbva-uruguay.name: BBVA Uruguay
bbva-uruguay.description: BBVA Uruguay is a financial institution and subsidiary of the Spanish bank Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria. It underwent several mergers throughout the 20th century before being acquired by BBVA in 2000. It operates in Uruguay's financial sector.

bac-credomatic.name: BAC Credomatic
bac-credomatic.description: BAC Credomatic is a financial group operating in Central America with presence in Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Panama, Grand Cayman, The Bahamas, and the United States. It provides financial services across these regions.

bahamasair.name: Bahamasair
bahamasair.description: Bahamasair Holdings Limited, operating as Bahamasair, is the flag carrier airline of The Bahamas headquartered in Nassau. It operates scheduled services to 32 domestic and regional destinations in the Caribbean and the United States from its base at Lynden Pindling International Airport.

banco-de-occidente-honduras.name: Banco de Occidente
banco-de-occidente-honduras.description: Banco de Occidente is a commercial bank headquartered in Santa Rosa de Copan, Honduras. It operates 170 branches nationwide, providing banking services across the country.

brasserie-nationale-d-haiti.name: Brasserie Nationale d'Haiti
brasserie-nationale-d-haiti.description: Brasserie Nationale d'Haïti, S.A. (BRANA) is a brewery and bottler in Haiti. It manufactures Prestige beer, an American-style lager produced in the Caribbean.

balistrad.name: Balistrad
balistrad.description: Balistrad is a Haitian online newspaper founded in 2018 by Fincy Pierre. It publishes content in French and Haitian Creole and operates as an independent media company producing web content.

bank-of-costa-rica.name: Bank of Costa Rica
bank-of-costa-rica.description: Banco de Costa Rica (BCR) is a state-owned commercial bank headquartered in San José, Costa Rica. Established in 1877 and nationalized in 1948, it is an autonomous state institution and one of the strongest banks in Costa Rica and Central America.

banco-economico.name: Banco Económico
banco-economico.description: Banco Económico is an Angolan bank based in Luanda, renamed in 2015 after the bankruptcy of its Portuguese parent bank. It was formerly known as Banco Espírito Santo Angola and is a subsidiary of Espírito Santo Financial Group.

boavida-group.name: Boavida Group
boavida-group.description: Grupo Boavida is an Angolan business conglomerate headquartered in Luanda, founded in 1996. It started in engineering and civil construction and expanded into real estate, agribusiness, and project management, leading large-scale residential and commercial projects.

banco-angolano-de-investimentos.name: Banco Angolano de Investimentos
banco-angolano-de-investimentos.description: Banco Angolano de Investimentos (BAI) was the first private bank in Angola, founded in 1996. It operates as a full-service bank with a nationwide network of branches across all provinces.

banque-de-tunisie.name: Banque de Tunisie
banque-de-tunisie.description: Banque de Tunisie is a bank in Tunisia and was the first modern bank established in the country. It has been publicly listed on the Bourse de Tunis since 1990. The bank operates within the financial sector of Tunisia.

banque-zitouna.name: Banque Zitouna
banque-zitouna.description: Banque Zitouna is the first Islamic bank in Tunisia and the Maghreb region. It has a capital of $30 million and aims to develop Islamic loan and saving products for both businesses and individuals.

bh-bank.name: BH Bank
bh-bank.description: BH Bank is a state-controlled bank in Tunisia. It is publicly listed on the Bourse de Tunis and operates within the country's banking sector.

banque-de-tunisie-et-des-emirats.name: Banque de Tunisie et des Emirats
banque-de-tunisie-et-des-emirats.legal_name: Banque de Tunisie et des Emirats
banque-de-tunisie-et-des-emirats.description: Banque de Tunisie et des Emirats (BTE) is a bank in Tunisia that is publicly listed on the Bourse de Tunis. It operates within the Tunisian banking sector.

bodega-aurrera.name: Bodega Aurrera
bodega-aurrera.description: Bodega Aurrerá is a Mexican discount store chain and subsidiary of Walmart de México y Centroamérica. Founded in 1970 in Mexico City, it was originally part of Grupo Cifra before Walmart acquired majority control in 1997. The brand serves the discount market sector.

badabun.name: Badabun
badabun.description: Badabun is a Mexican audiovisual production company that creates digital content primarily on YouTube. Founded in 2014, it gained popularity through humorous videos and internet celebrity collaborations. Badabun was recognized as the most popular Spanish-language channel on YouTube in 2019.

banco-azteca.name: Banco Azteca
banco-azteca.description: Banco Azteca is a financial institution headquartered in Mexico and part of Grupo Elektra and Grupo Salinas. Founded in 2002 by Ricardo Salinas Pliego, it focuses on promoting financial inclusion by serving middle and lower income groups often neglected by traditional banking.

banbajio.name: BanBajío
banbajio.description: Banco del Bajío, known as BanBajío, is a Mexican bank headquartered in León, Guanajuato. It is one of the major and fastest growing local banks in Mexico, ranking eighth in customer deposits and providing lending services.

banregio.name: BanRegio
banregio.description: Banregio Grupo Financiero, operating as BanRegio, is a Mexican regional bank headquartered in San Pedro Garza García near Monterrey. It offers financial services such as business loans, leasing, factoring, and working capital loans mainly to small and medium-sized companies.

bancomext.name: Bancomext
bancomext.description: Banco Nacional de Comercio Exterior (Bancomext) is a Mexican state-owned bank and export credit agency established in 1937. Its purpose is to promote foreign trade and support the export activities of Mexican companies.

botswanapost.name: BotswanaPost
botswanapost.description: BotswanaPost is the company responsible for postal services in Botswana. It is a government-owned parastatal under the Ministry of Transport and Communications.

botswana-red-cross-society.name: Botswana Red Cross Society
botswana-red-cross-society.description: The Botswana Red Cross Society, also known as LRC, was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Gaborone, Botswana.

burkinabe-red-cross-society.name: Burkinabé Red Cross Society
burkinabe-red-cross-society.description: The Burkinabé Red Cross Society was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso.

burundi-red-cross.name: Burundi Red Cross
burundi-red-cross.description: Burundi Red Cross, founded in 1963, is a humanitarian organization based in Bujumbura, Burundi. It was established based on the Geneva Conventions and Additional Protocols. The organization provides emergency and relief services in the country.

bracongo.name: Bracongo
bracongo.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
bracongo.description: Bracongo is a brewery headquartered in Limete, Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo. It is part of Société des Brasseries et Glacières Internationales, which operates breweries across Africa. This group is owned by the French Groupe Castel.

bralima-brewery.name: Bralima Brewery
bralima-brewery.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
bralima-brewery.description: Bralima Brewery is a public limited liability company producing beer and soft beverages. It is headquartered on Avenue du Drapeau in Barumbu, Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo. The company operates in the beverage industry.
